quote: Mortality rates in all populations of crucian carp subjected to PFOS exposure escalated within 24 h, revealing a dose- and time-dependent toxicity pattern characterized by an increase in lethality with higher PFOS concentrations and prolonged exposure periods.
statement: 暴露于PFOS的所有鲫鱼种群在24小时内死亡率上升，显示出剂量和时间依赖性的毒性模式，其特征是随着PFOS浓度升高和暴露时间延长，致死率增加。
text_zh: 暴露于PFOS的所有鲫鱼种群在24小时内死亡率上升，显示出剂量和时间依赖性的毒性模式，其特征是随着PFOS浓度升高和暴露时间延长，致死率增加。
text_en: All crucian carp populations exposed to PFOS showed increased mortality within 24 hours, exhibiting a dose- and time-dependent toxicity pattern characterized by increasing lethality with rising PFOS concentration and prolonged exposure time.

quote: Through linear regression, we derived the regression equation, thereby quantifying the relationship between PFOS concentration and fish mortality.
statement: 通过线性回归推导了回归方程，从而量化了PFOS浓度与鱼类死亡率之间的关系。
text_zh: 通过线性回归推导了回归方程，从而量化了PFOS浓度与鱼类死亡率之间的关系。
text_en: A regression equation was derived through linear regression to quantify the relationship between PFOS concentration and fish mortality.

quote: Our findings reveal that the 96 h LC 50 value is 23.17 mg/L.
statement: 研究结果显示96小时LC50值为23.17 mg/L。
text_zh: 研究结果显示96小时LC50值为23.17 mg/L。
text_en: The study results showed a 96-hour LC50 value of 23.17 mg/L.

quote: No difference in standard length between infected and uninfected individuals was observed (Mann–Whitney U test: U = 1750.00, p = 0.870).
statement: 未观察到感染个体与未感染个体在标准体长上的差异。
text_zh: 未观察到感染个体与未感染个体在标准体长上的差异。
text_en: No difference in standard body length was observed between infected and uninfected individuals.

quote: only fish weight significantly differed between infected males and females (Mann–Whitney U test: U = 17.00, p = 0.024).
statement: 仅在感染雄性和雌性之间，鱼体重存在显著差异。
text_zh: 仅在感染雄性和雌性之间，鱼体重存在显著差异。
text_en: A significant difference in fish body weight existed only between infected males and females.

quote: Spearman’s correlation coefficient revealed significant negative correlation between CF and each of the three parasite infection parameters (Table 3).
statement: Spearman相关系数显示，肥满度（CF）与三个寄生虫感染参数中的每一个均呈显著负相关。
text_zh: Spearman相关系数显示，肥满度（CF）与三个寄生虫感染参数中的每一个均呈显著负相关。
text_en: Spearman correlation coefficients showed that condition factor (CF) was significantly negatively correlated with each of the three parasite infection parameters.
outcome: 健康状况与感染程度关系

quote: if this nematode has a detectable negative impact on a resilient species as the Prussian carp, it is important to monitor its occurrence in other fish species
statement: 如果该线虫对普鲁士鲤鱼等韧性物种有可检测的负面影响，则监测其在其他鱼类中的出现情况很重要。
text_zh: 如果该线虫对普鲁士鲤鱼等韧性物种有可检测的负面影响，则监测其在其他鱼类中的出现情况很重要。
text_en: If this nematode has a detectable negative impact on resilient species such as Prussian carp, it is important to monitor its occurrence in other fish.
outcome: 寄生虫感染与疾病监测

quote: The negative influence of nematode parasites on invasive fish-species was evident in the changes of the growth capacity, i.e., lack of allometric growth pattern.
statement: 线虫寄生虫对入侵鱼类物种的负面影响体现在生长能力的变化上，即缺乏异速生长模式。
text_zh: 线虫寄生虫对入侵鱼类物种的负面影响体现在生长能力的变化上，即缺乏异速生长模式。
text_en: The negative impact of nematode parasites on invasive fish species is reflected in changes in growth capacity, namely the lack of allometric growth patterns.

quote: The effect of Contracaecum sp. larvae on the health of their host, the Prussian carp, was determined by estimating the effect of the parasites’ presence, number, and biomass on fish length, weight, and the Fulton’s condition factor.
statement: 通过估计寄生虫的存在、数量和生物量对鱼体长、体重和肥满度的影响，来确定Contracaecum属幼虫对其宿主普鲁士鲤鱼健康的影响。
text_zh: 通过估计寄生虫的存在、数量和生物量对鱼体长、体重和肥满度的影响，来确定Contracaecum属幼虫对其宿主普鲁士鲤鱼健康的影响。
text_en: To determine the impact of Contracaecum genus larvae on the health of their host, Prussian carp, by estimating the effects of parasite presence, abundance, and biomass on fish body length, weight, and condition factor.

quote: Compared to the standard visual inspection, Shamsi and Suthar [ 59 ] recorded higher values of prevalence, mean abundance and mean intensity using the incubation method.
statement: 与标准视觉检查相比，Shamsi和Suthar使用孵育法记录了更高的患病率、平均丰度和平均强度值。
text_zh: 与标准视觉检查相比，Shamsi和Suthar使用孵育法记录了更高的患病率、平均丰度和平均强度值。
text_en: Compared to standard visual examination, Shamsi and Suthar recorded higher prevalence, mean abundance, and mean intensity values using the incubation method.

quote: In parasitological research, these parameters can be used to describe effects of parasite infections on host health [ 68 ].
statement: 在寄生虫学研究中，这些参数可用于描述寄生虫感染对宿主健康的影响。
text_zh: 在寄生虫学研究中，这些参数可用于描述寄生虫感染对宿主健康的影响。
text_en: In parasitological studies, these parameters can be used to describe the impact of parasite infection on host health.
intervention: Fulton condition factor and length-weight relationship
intervention_record: 肥满度与体长体重关系

quote: Hasil penelitian yang diperoleh untuk perlakuan suhu yang terbaik adalah perlakuan B dengan perlakuan suhu 28oC dengan daya tetas sebesar 73,33%.
statement: Perlakuan suhu 28°C menghasilkan daya tetas sebesar 73,33%, yang merupakan hasil terbaik dalam penelitian ini.
text_en: Perlakuan suhu 28°C menghasilkan daya tetas sebesar 73,33%, yang merupakan hasil terbaik dalam penelitian ini.

quote: Putri et al, (2013) menyatakan bahwa faktor kualitas air terutama suhu merupakan faktor yang sangat penting dalam kehidupan organisme, perubahan suhu memberikan pengaruh yang sangat kuat terhadap proses fisiologis dan biologis, suhu merupakan faktor lingkungan yang berpengaruh terhadap perkembangan embrio yang nantinya akan menetas.
statement: Suhu sebagai faktor kualitas air sangat penting bagi kehidupan organisme, mempengaruhi proses fisiologis, biologis, dan perkembangan embrio.
text_en: Suhu sebagai faktor kualitas air sangat penting bagi kehidupan organisme, mempengaruhi proses fisiologis, biologis, dan perkembangan embrio.

quote: Data pada Gambar 3 menunjukan bahwa daya tetas telur ikan komet tertinggi terjadi pada perlakuan B (suhu 28oC) yaitu sebesar 73,33%, kemudian diikuti perlakuan C (suhu 30oC) sebesar 61,67 %, selanjutnya perlakuan A (suhu 26oC) sebesar 61,33%, dan untuk daya tetas terendah terdapat pada perlakuan D (suhu 32oC) yaitu sebesar 45%.
statement: Daya tetas telur tertinggi dicapai pada suhu 28°C (73,33%) dan terendah pada suhu 32°C (45%).
text_en: Daya tetas telur tertinggi dicapai pada suhu 28°C (73,33%) dan terendah pada suhu 32°C (45%).

quote: Contracaecum larvae have the tendency to migrate from the intestine to surrounding host’s organs by burrowing through tissue, causing mechanical damage along the way and eliciting an immune response [ 54 , 55 ].
statement: Contracaecum larvae tend to migrate from the intestine to other organs, causing mechanical tissue damage and triggering an immune response.
text_en: Contracaecum larvae tend to migrate from the intestine to other organs, causing mechanical tissue damage and triggering an immune response.
outcome: Mechanical damage and immune response due to parasite migration

quote: Both nets were placed in the lake at specific sites and left overnight for a 12-h period.
statement: 两张网被放置在湖中的特定地点并过夜停留12小时。
text_zh: 两张网被放置在湖中的特定地点并过夜停留12小时。
text_en: Two nets were placed at specific locations in the lake and left overnight for 12 hours.

quote: Each individual was firstly removed from the net, followed by the external inspection for macroscopic ectoparasites, which included thorough inspection of nostrils, eyes, gills, fins, scales, and underneath the operculum [ 79 ].
statement: 每条鱼首先从网中取出，随后进行外部检查以寻找宏观体外寄生虫，包括对鼻孔、眼睛、鳃、鳍、鳞片和鳃盖下方的彻底检查。
text_zh: 每条鱼首先从网中取出，随后进行外部检查以寻找宏观体外寄生虫，包括对鼻孔、眼睛、鳃、鳍、鳞片和鳃盖下方的彻底检查。
text_en: Each fish is first removed from the net, then undergoes an external examination to look for macroscopic ectoparasites, including a thorough inspection of the nostrils, eyes, gills, fins, scales, and under the operculum.

quote: In the field, fish were sacrificed and a necropsy was performed starting with incisions along the ventral length, subsequently followed by incisions on the lateral sides leading dorsally.
statement: 在野外，鱼被处死并进行尸检，从沿腹侧长度切口开始，随后是通向背侧的侧面切口。
text_zh: 在野外，鱼被处死并进行尸检，从沿腹侧长度切口开始，随后是通向背侧的侧面切口。
text_en: In the field, fish were euthanized and necropsied, starting with a ventral midline incision along the length of the body, followed by lateral incisions towards the dorsal side.

quote: Similarly, b coefficient value for length-weight relationships in infected fish was also lower (2.00) compared to both the healthy (3.32) and the mean b value of the Prussian carp populations in Croatia (3.29) [ 72 ].
statement: 同样，感染鱼的长宽关系的b系数值也低于健康鱼（3.32）和克罗地亚普鲁士鲤鱼种群的b平均值（3.29）。
text_zh: 同样，感染鱼的长宽关系的b系数值也低于健康鱼（3.32）和克罗地亚普鲁士鲤鱼种群的b平均值（3.29）。
text_en: Similarly, the b coefficient of the length-weight relationship in infected fish was also lower than that of healthy fish (3.32) and the mean b value of the Croatian Prussian carp population (3.29).

quote: Since condition factor assumes heavier fish are in a better condition [ 73 , 74 ], results obtained in this research suggest that presence of Contracaecum larvae has detrimental effects on health of the infected Prussian carp.
statement: 由于肥满度假设较重的鱼状况更好，本研究的结果表明Contracaecum幼虫的存在对被感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的健康有不利影响。
text_zh: 由于肥满度假设较重的鱼状况更好，本研究的结果表明Contracaecum幼虫的存在对被感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的健康有不利影响。
text_en: Since heavier fish were assumed to be in better condition, the results of this study indicate that the presence of Contracaecum larvae has an adverse effect on the health of infected Prussian carp.

quote: Similar findings have been reported in Hoplias malabaricus that were infected with Contracaecum parasites [ 5 ].
statement: 在感染Contracaecum寄生虫的Hoplias malabaricus中也报告了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在感染Contracaecum寄生虫的Hoplias malabaricus中也报告了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were also reported in Hoplias malabaricus infected with Contracaecum parasites.

quote: On the other hand, Clarias gariepinus shows resistance to adverse effects of Contracaecum infection [ 75 ] and did not show lower values of mean condition factor in infected individuals [ 17 ].
statement: 另一方面，Clarias gariepinus表现出对Contracaecum感染不利影响的抵抗力，且受感染个体的平均肥满度值并未降低。
text_zh: 另一方面，Clarias gariepinus表现出对Contracaecum感染不利影响的抵抗力，且受感染个体的平均肥满度值并未降低。
text_en: On the other hand, Clarias gariepinus showed resistance to the adverse effects of Contracaecum infection, and the average condition factor values of infected individuals did not decrease.

quote: Third stage Contracaecum larvae do not seem to cause significant pathological changes in the Prussian carp, apart from a mild local tissue inflammation, as observed in this study and additionally by İnnal et al. [ 41 ].
statement: 除了观察到的轻微局部组织炎症外，第三期Contracaecum幼虫似乎不会在普鲁士鲤鱼中引起显著的病理变化。
text_zh: 除了观察到的轻微局部组织炎症外，第三期Contracaecum幼虫似乎不会在普鲁士鲤鱼中引起显著的病理变化。
text_en: Apart from the observed mild local tissue inflammation, third-stage Contracaecum larvae do not appear to cause significant pathological changes in Prussian carp.

quote: Non-parametric Mann–Whitney U test for two independent samples was used for testing the effects of parasites on parameters that reflect health of fish population.
statement: 使用非参数Mann-Whitney U检验测试寄生虫对反映鱼群健康参数的影响。
text_zh: 使用非参数Mann-Whitney U检验测试寄生虫对反映鱼群健康参数的影响。
text_en: The non-parametric Mann-Whitney U test was used to test the effect of parasites on parameters reflecting fish health.

quote: Putri et al. (2013) stated that water quality factors, especially temperature, were very important factors in the life of the organism.
statement: Putri et al. (2013) menyatakan bahwa faktor kualitas air, terutama suhu, merupakan faktor yang sangat penting dalam kehidupan organisme.
text_en: Putri et al. (2013) menyatakan bahwa faktor kualitas air, terutama suhu, merupakan faktor yang sangat penting dalam kehidupan organisme.

quote: Treatment A: Temperature 26 oC + Eggs 100 grains, Treatment B: Temperature 28oC + Eggs 100 grains, Treatment C: Temperature 30 oC + Egg 100 grains, Treatment D: Temperature 32oC + Eggs 100 grains.
statement: Perlakuan terdiri atas suhu 26°C, 28°C, 30°C, dan 32°C dengan masing-masing menggunakan 100 butir telur.
text_en: Perlakuan terdiri atas suhu 26°C, 28°C, 30°C, dan 32°C dengan masing-masing menggunakan 100 butir telur.

quote: The results obtained for the best temperature treatment were treatment B with a temperature treatment of 28oC with hatchability of 73.33%.
statement: Hasil terbaik diperoleh pada perlakuan B dengan suhu 28°C yang menghasilkan daya tetas sebesar 73,33%.
text_en: Hasil terbaik diperoleh pada perlakuan B dengan suhu 28°C yang menghasilkan daya tetas sebesar 73,33%.

quote: Infected individuals of Prussian carp in this study showed significantly lower values of Fulton’s condition factor compared to uninfected individuals, along with a negative correlation between the fish condition factor and parasite burden.
statement: 本研究中，感染寄生虫的普鲁士鲤鱼个体的福尔顿肥满度值显著低于未感染个体，且鱼体肥满度与寄生虫负荷呈负相关。
text_zh: 本研究中，感染寄生虫的普鲁士鲤鱼个体的福尔顿肥满度值显著低于未感染个体，且鱼体肥满度与寄生虫负荷呈负相关。
text_en: In this study, the Fulton condition factor of Prussian carp individuals infected with parasites was significantly lower than that of uninfected individuals, and fish body condition was negatively correlated with parasite load.

quote: Even though the uninfected Prussian carp in this study had higher mean condition factor values compared to those recorded in Croatia (2.08 ± 0.34 and 1.79, respectively) [ 71 ], the infected Prussian carp had a mean value lower than both of the aforementioned (1.64 ± 0.14).
statement: 尽管本研究中未感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的平均肥满度值高于克罗地亚记录的值（分别为2.08 ± 0.34和1.79），但感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的平均值低于上述两者（1.64 ± 0.14）。
text_zh: 尽管本研究中未感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的平均肥满度值高于克罗地亚记录的值（分别为2.08 ± 0.34和1.79），但感染的普鲁士鲤鱼的平均值低于上述两者（1.64 ± 0.14）。
text_en: Although the average condition factor of uninfected Prussian carp in this study was higher than the value recorded in Croatia (2.08 ± 0.34 and 1.79, respectively), the average for infected Prussian carp was lower than both of these values (1.64 ± 0.14).

quote: Treatment groups 3 and 4 showed a lower amount of chromium reabsorption in the gills, liver, kidneys, and muscles compared to the positive control group, demonstrating a significant difference.
statement: 处理组3和4在鳃、肝脏、肾脏和肌肉中的铬重吸收量低于阳性对照组，显示出显著差异。
text_zh: 处理组3和4在鳃、肝脏、肾脏和肌肉中的铬重吸收量低于阳性对照组，显示出显著差异。
text_en: Treatment groups 3 and 4 had significantly lower chromium reabsorption in the gills, liver, kidney, and muscle than the positive control group.

quote: Therefore, it can be concluded that irradiated alcohol extract of propolis is recommended as a suitable and convenient food additive to increase its antioxidant properties in the fish industry.
statement: 因此可以得出结论，辐照酒精提取的蜂胶被推荐为适合且方便的饲料添加剂，以增加其在渔业中的抗氧化特性。
text_zh: 因此可以得出结论，辐照酒精提取的蜂胶被推荐为适合且方便的饲料添加剂，以增加其在渔业中的抗氧化特性。
text_en: Therefore, it can be concluded that irradiated alcohol-extracted propolis is recommended as a suitable and convenient feed additive to increase its antioxidant properties in fisheries.

quote: Menurut Wardoyo dalam Kalabora, (2010) bahwa batas toleransi amoniak dalam air berkisar antara 0.1–0.3 ppm.
statement: Batas toleransi amoniak dalam air untuk penetasan telur berkisar antara 0.1–0.3 ppm menurut referensi tersebut.
text_en: Batas toleransi amoniak dalam air untuk penetasan telur berkisar antara 0.1–0.3 ppm menurut referensi tersebut.

quote: Haris dalam Fahrurrazi, (2013) menyatakan bahwa kisaran suhu siang dan malam merupakan kelemahan yang sering ditemui dalam pembenihan yang tidak terkontrol.
statement: Fluktuasi suhu siang dan malam merupakan kelemahan dalam pembenihan yang tidak terkontrol.
text_en: Fluktuasi suhu siang dan malam merupakan kelemahan dalam pembenihan yang tidak terkontrol.

quote: Kenaikan dan penurunan suhu secara mendadak akan menghambat terjadinya penetasan telur.
statement: Perubahan suhu mendadak menghambat penetasan telur.
text_en: Perubahan suhu mendadak menghambat penetasan telur.

quote: Adapun alat yang digunakan dalam pelaksanaan penelitian optimalisasi suhu terhadap daya tetas (Hatching Rate) telur ikan komet (C. auratus) antara lain akuarium, mikroskop,saringan, piring, serok halus, aerator, alat tulis, kamera digital, mistar, heater, thermometer, gelas ukur, selang sifon, pH meter.
statement: Alat yang digunakan termasuk heater dan thermometer untuk mengatur dan mengukur suhu dalam penelitian daya tetas telur.
text_en: Alat yang digunakan termasuk heater dan thermometer untuk mengatur dan mengukur suhu dalam penelitian daya tetas telur.

quote: Wadah yang digunakan dalam pelaksanaan penelitian ini adalah akuarium yang berukuran 60 × 30 × 30 cm, sebanyak 12 akuarium sesuai dengan perlakuan yaitu perlakuan A : suhu 26oC, perlakuan B : suhu 28oC, perlakuan C : suhu 30oC dan perlakuan D : suhu 32oC.
statement: Penelitian menggunakan akuarium dengan empat perlakuan suhu berbeda (26°C, 28°C, 30°C, dan 32°C) untuk inkubasi telur.
text_en: Penelitian menggunakan akuarium dengan empat perlakuan suhu berbeda (26°C, 28°C, 30°C, dan 32°C) untuk inkubasi telur.

quote: Air yang digunakan dalam akuarium berupa air sumur, hal ini bertujuan agar kondisi air dalam akuarium tidak terlalu banyak mengalami perubahan fisika dan kimia, sehingga tidak mempengaruhi kondisi telur.
statement: Penggunaan air sumur bertujuan menjaga stabilitas parameter fisika dan kimia air agar tidak mempengaruhi kondisi telur.
text_en: Penggunaan air sumur bertujuan menjaga stabilitas parameter fisika dan kimia air agar tidak mempengaruhi kondisi telur.

quote: Berdasarkan hasil analisis sidik ragam pada taraf 5% (Lampiran 3) menunjukkan bahwa penetasan telur dengan suhu air berbeda memberikan pengaruh yang berbeda nyata terhadap daya tetas telur ikan komet.
statement: Penetasan telur dengan suhu air yang berbeda memberikan pengaruh nyata terhadap daya tetas telur ikan komet.
text_en: Penetasan telur dengan suhu air yang berbeda memberikan pengaruh nyata terhadap daya tetas telur ikan komet.

quote: Tingginya daya tetas telur pada perlakuan B (suhu 28oC) diduga merupakan suhu optimal pada proses penetasan telur ikan komet.
statement: Suhu 28°C diduga merupakan suhu optimal untuk proses penetasan telur ikan komet.
text_en: Suhu 28°C diduga merupakan suhu optimal untuk proses penetasan telur ikan komet.

quote: Suhu optimal pada proses penetasan menyebabkan proses metabolisme berlangsung baik, sehingga perkembangan embrio akan berlangsung sempurna hingga telur menetas.
statement: Suhu optimal memungkinkan metabolisme berjalan baik sehingga perkembangan embrio sempurna hingga menetas.
text_en: Suhu optimal memungkinkan metabolisme berjalan baik sehingga perkembangan embrio sempurna hingga menetas.

quote: Rendahnya daya tetas telur pada perlakuan A, C dan perlakuan D diduga karena suhu yang terlalu rendah dan terlalu tinggi menyebabkan perkembangan embrio menjadi tidak sempurna.
statement: Daya tetas rendah pada perlakuan lain diduga disebabkan oleh suhu yang terlalu rendah atau terlalu tinggi yang menghambat kesempurnaan perkembangan embrio.
text_en: Daya tetas rendah pada perlakuan lain diduga disebabkan oleh suhu yang terlalu rendah atau terlalu tinggi yang menghambat kesempurnaan perkembangan embrio.

quote: Jika suhu media terus meningkat melebihi suhu optimal maka daya tetas telur akan berangsur menurun.
statement: Suhu media yang melebihi suhu optimal menyebabkan penurunan daya tetas telur.
text_en: Suhu media yang melebihi suhu optimal menyebabkan penurunan daya tetas telur.

quote: Due to its medicinal properties such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antibacterial, bacteriostatic, antiseptic, and immune stimulants, it is also known
statement: 蜂胶因其具有抗炎、抗氧化、抗菌、抑菌、防腐和免疫刺激等药用特性而为人所知。
text_zh: 蜂胶因其具有抗炎、抗氧化、抗菌、抑菌、防腐和免疫刺激等药用特性而为人所知。
text_en: Propolis is known for its medicinal properties such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antibacterial, bacteriostatic, preservative, and immunostimulatory effects.

quote: propolis can be a natural supplement that has the potential to improve the health and safety of fish and thus increase the growth and productivity of the fish industry as well as economic efficiency
statement: 蜂胶可以作为一种天然补充剂，具有改善鱼类健康和安全的潜力，从而增加渔业的增长和生产率以及经济效率。
text_zh: 蜂胶可以作为一种天然补充剂，具有改善鱼类健康和安全的潜力，从而增加渔业的增长和生产率以及经济效率。
text_en: Propolis can serve as a natural supplement with the potential to improve fish health and safety, thereby increasing fisheries growth and productivity as well as economic efficiency.

quote: The aim of this work was to investigate whether using alcoholic extract and crushed raw propolis processed with radiation can reduce the reabsorption of harmful pollutant chromium (potassium dichromate) in different tissues of the Redfish, Carassius auratus.
statement: 本研究的目的是调查使用酒精提取物和经辐射处理的破碎生蜂胶是否能减少红鱼（Carassius auratus）不同组织中有害污染物铬（重铬酸钾）的重吸收。
text_zh: 本研究的目的是调查使用酒精提取物和经辐射处理的破碎生蜂胶是否能减少红鱼（Carassius auratus）不同组织中有害污染物铬（重铬酸钾）的重吸收。
text_en: The purpose of this study was to investigate whether the use of alcohol extracts and irradiated raw propolis fragments could reduce the reabsorption of harmful pollutant chromium (potassium dichromate) in different tissues of red fish (Carassius auratus).
intervention: Alcohol extract and irradiated raw propolis
intervention_record: 酒精提取与辐照生蜂胶

quote: Proses penetasan telur akan terganggu pada suhu tinggi sehingga dapat menyebabkan kerusakan pada jaringan sel telur.
statement: Suhu tinggi mengganggu proses penetasan dan merusak jaringan sel telur.
text_en: Suhu tinggi mengganggu proses penetasan dan merusak jaringan sel telur.

quote: Suhu yang sangat tinggi akan mempercepat laju penetasan telur sehingga telur tidak dapat melewati fase-fase penetasan telur dengan sempurna.
statement: Suhu sangat tinggi mempercepat laju penetasan sehingga embrio tidak menyelesaikan fase penetasan dengan sempurna.
text_en: Suhu sangat tinggi mempercepat laju penetasan sehingga embrio tidak menyelesaikan fase penetasan dengan sempurna.

quote: Ketidaksesuaian suhu dapat menyebabkankematian embrio terutama pada fase perkembangan embrio.
statement: Ketidaksesuaian suhu dapat menyebabkan kematian embrio, terutama pada fase perkembangan.
text_en: Ketidaksesuaian suhu dapat menyebabkan kematian embrio, terutama pada fase perkembangan.

quote: Pada saat proses penetasan telur, suhu yang tinggi akan mempercepat metabolisme, sehingga perkembangan telur akan semakin cepat, tetapi dapat menghambat proses penetasan dan menyebabkan kematian.
statement: Suhu tinggi mempercepat metabolisme dan perkembangan telur namun dapat menghambat penetasan dan menyebabkan kematian.
text_en: Suhu tinggi mempercepat metabolisme dan perkembangan telur namun dapat menghambat penetasan dan menyebabkan kematian.

quote: Sebaliknya suhu yang rendah membuat enzim (Chorion) tidak bekerja dengan baik pada kulit telur dan membuat embrio akan lama dalam melarutkan kulit, sehingga embrio akan menetas lebih lama.
statement: Suhu rendah menghambat kerja enzim chorion sehingga memperpanjang waktu penetasan.
text_en: Suhu rendah menghambat kerja enzim chorion sehingga memperpanjang waktu penetasan.

quote: Derajat kesasaman pH selama penelitian adalah berkisar antara 7,30 sampai 7,70. Kisaran ini masih berada dalam kisaran yang mendukung untuk kehidupan ikan.
statement: Rentang pH 7,30-7,70 selama penelitian dianggap mendukung kehidupan ikan.
text_en: Rentang pH 7,30-7,70 selama penelitian dianggap mendukung kehidupan ikan.

quote: Hal ini sesuai dengan Hadid et al (2014), yang menyatakan kisaran pH yang baik untuk penetasan telur adalah 6,9 – 9,0.
statement: Hadid et al (2014) menyatakan bahwa kisaran pH 6,9–9,0 baik untuk penetasan telur.
text_en: Hadid et al (2014) menyatakan bahwa kisaran pH 6,9–9,0 baik untuk penetasan telur.

quote: Oksigen terlarut selama penelitian masih dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.
statement: Kadar oksigen terlarut selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.
text_en: Kadar oksigen terlarut selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.

quote: Menurut Effendi, (2003) kadar DO 1,0 – 5,0 mg/l ikan dapat bertahan hidup tetapi pertumbuhan terganggu, sedangkan kadar DO > 5,0 mg/l kadar DO yang disukai oleh semua organisme perairan.
statement: Effendi (2003) menyatakan bahwa DO 1,0–5,0 mg/l memungkinkan kelangsungan hidup tetapi menghambat pertumbuhan, sementara DO > 5,0 mg/l disukai oleh semua organisme perairan.
text_en: Effendi (2003) menyatakan bahwa DO 1,0–5,0 mg/l memungkinkan kelangsungan hidup tetapi menghambat pertumbuhan, sementara DO > 5,0 mg/l disukai oleh semua organisme perairan.

quote: Kandungan ammonia selama penelitian masi dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.
statement: Kandungan amonia selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.
text_en: Kandungan amonia selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran toleransi untuk penetasan telur.

quote: Aeration in the tanks was done by using air stones and changing the water in the tanks daily with fresh water (30%).
statement: 养殖池通过气石曝气并每日更换30%的新鲜水来维持水质。
text_zh: 养殖池通过气石曝气并每日更换30%的新鲜水来维持水质。
text_en: The culture pond maintains water quality by aerating with air stones and replacing 30% of the water with fresh water daily.
outcome: 水体溶解氧与水质稳定性

quote: Fish were fed twice a day at 10:00 and 17:00 at the rate of 3% of the fish biomass and the rations were adjusted once every two weeks according to the body weight of the fish.
statement: 鱼每天在10:00和17:00投喂两次，投喂量为鱼生物量的3%，并根据体重每两周调整一次饲料量。
text_zh: 鱼每天在10:00和17:00投喂两次，投喂量为鱼生物量的3%，并根据体重每两周调整一次饲料量。
text_en: Fish are fed twice daily at 10:00 and 17:00, with a feed amount of 3% of fish biomass, adjusted every two weeks based on body weight.

quote: Then, all the treatment and positive control groups, except the negative control group, were exposed to 9 mg/L of chromium as potassium dichromate for 6 weeks (El-Borai et al. 2018).
statement: 除阴性对照组外，所有处理组和阳性对照组均暴露于9 mg/L的重铬酸钾（以铬计）中6周。
text_zh: 除阴性对照组外，所有处理组和阳性对照组均暴露于9 mg/L的重铬酸钾（以铬计）中6周。
text_en: Except for the negative control group, all treatment groups and the positive control group were exposed to 9 mg/L potassium dichromate (as chromium) for 6 weeks.

quote: At the end of the experimental period (day 70), 9 fish from each glass tank were randomly anaesthetized with clove extract (50 g/L) and dissected to collect samples (Keene et al. 1998).
statement: 实验结束时，从每个玻璃缸中随机选取9条鱼，使用丁香提取物（50 g/L）麻醉并进行解剖采样。
text_zh: 实验结束时，从每个玻璃缸中随机选取9条鱼，使用丁香提取物（50 g/L）麻醉并进行解剖采样。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, 9 fish were randomly selected from each glass tank, anesthetized using clove extract (50 g/L), and dissected for sampling.
outcome: 操作过程中的应激控制

statement: 与阳性对照组相比，蜂胶处理组肝脏中的铬含量有所降低（数值从2.48降至1.88-2.19 mg/kg DM），但部分差异标记显示重叠。
text_zh: 与阳性对照组相比，蜂胶处理组肝脏中的铬含量有所降低（数值从2.48降至1.88-2.19 mg/kg DM），但部分差异标记显示重叠。
text_en: Compared with the positive control group, chromium content in the liver of the propolis-treated group decreased (values from 2.48 to 1.88-2.19 mg/kg DM), but some difference markers showed overlap.

quote: All treatments showed a significant decrease in chromium metal reabsorption in muscle compared to the positive control group (P < 0.05).
statement: 所有处理组与阳性对照组相比，肌肉中的铬金属重吸收均显著降低。
text_zh: 所有处理组与阳性对照组相比，肌肉中的铬金属重吸收均显著降低。
text_en: In all treatment groups, chromium metal reabsorption in muscle was significantly reduced compared to the positive control group.

quote: Moreover, an excessive amount of hexavalent chromium has been found to lead to oxidative toxicity, and genotoxicity in aquatic organisms (Burgos-Aceves and Faggio 2017; Ekek et al. 2018; Shahjahan et al. 2022).
statement: 过量的六价铬会导致水生生物产生氧化毒性和基因毒性。
text_zh: 过量的六价铬会导致水生生物产生氧化毒性和基因毒性。
text_en: Excess hexavalent chromium causes oxidative toxicity and genotoxicity in aquatic organisms.

quote: Hexavalent chromium is also found in chromite CrO4 − 2 and CrO7 − 2 (Ahmed et al. 2013), and also in these forms, has the properties of permeability and biotransformation of chromium, which ultimately lead to cytotoxicity and mutagenic activities in fish (Safiur et al. 2012).
statement: 六价铬存在于铬酸盐形式中，这些形式具有铬的渗透性和生物转化特性，最终导致鱼类产生细胞毒性和致突变活性。
text_zh: 六价铬存在于铬酸盐形式中，这些形式具有铬的渗透性和生物转化特性，最终导致鱼类产生细胞毒性和致突变活性。
text_en: Hexavalent chromium exists in chromate forms, which have the permeability and biotransformation characteristics of chromium, ultimately leading to cytotoxicity and mutagenic activity in fish.

quote:
The effects of chromium toxicity,
including its effect on the quality of fish fillets, may be related to the production of reactive oxygen
species (ROS) and changes in endogenous antioxidants (Zhong et al. 2017).
statement: 铬毒性对鱼片质量的影响可能与活性氧（ROS）的产生和内源性抗氧化剂的变化有关。
text_zh: 铬毒性对鱼片质量的影响可能与活性氧（ROS）的产生和内源性抗氧化剂的变化有关。
text_en: The effect of chromium toxicity on fish fillet quality may be related to the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and changes in endogenous antioxidants.

quote:
Excessive activity of ROS
leads to reactions with biological macromolecules up to the level of lipid peroxidation (LPO), and
changes in the activity of antioxidant enzymes, including catalase (CAT), superoxide dismutase (SOD),
and glutathione (Barathinivas et al. 2022; Ekek et al. 2018; Filice et al. 2023).
statement: 过量的活性氧会导致与生物大分子反应直至脂质过氧化水平，并改变包括过氧化氢酶、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽在内的抗氧化酶的活性。
text_zh: 过量的活性氧会导致与生物大分子反应直至脂质过氧化水平，并改变包括过氧化氢酶、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽在内的抗氧化酶的活性。
text_en: Excessive reactive oxygen species react with biological macromolecules up to the level of lipid peroxidation and alter the activity of antioxidant enzymes including catalase, superoxide dismutase, and glutathione.
outcome: 脂质过氧化与抗氧化酶活性

quote:
The results indicated that the glutathione system may be responsible for the
protection against the harmful effects of dichromate in fish and indicate the possible development of an
adaptive response during the 96-hour treatment with the toxin.
statement: 结果表明谷胱甘肽系统可能负责保护鱼类免受重铬酸盐的有害影响，并表明在96小时毒素处理期间可能发展出适应性反应。
text_zh: 结果表明谷胱甘肽系统可能负责保护鱼类免受重铬酸盐的有害影响，并表明在96小时毒素处理期间可能发展出适应性反应。
text_en: The results indicate that the glutathione system may be responsible for protecting fish from the harmful effects of dichromate, and suggest that an adaptive response may develop during the 96-hour toxin treatment.
outcome: 适应性反应与保护机制

quote:
By neutralizing ROS (Gulhan et al. 2014),
natural antioxidants create an optimal balance in fish health, and as a result, are involved in increasing
resistance to environmental pollution for aquatic animals.
statement: 通过中和活性氧，天然抗氧化剂在鱼类健康中创造最佳平衡，从而参与提高水生动物对环境污染的抵抗力。
text_zh: 通过中和活性氧，天然抗氧化剂在鱼类健康中创造最佳平衡，从而参与提高水生动物对环境污染的抵抗力。
text_en: By neutralizing reactive oxygen species, natural antioxidants create an optimal balance in fish health, thereby participating in improving the resistance of aquatic animals to environmental pollution.

quote: Treatments and the positive control groups were exposed to 9 mg/L of chromium for 6 weeks.
statement: 处理组和阳性对照组暴露于9 mg/L的铬中6周。
text_zh: 处理组和阳性对照组暴露于9 mg/L的铬中6周。
text_en: The treatment group and the positive control group were exposed to 9 mg/L of chromium for 6 weeks.

quote: The irradiated propolis diet treatment groups showed a significant difference compared to the positive control group.
statement: 辐照蜂胶日粮处理组与阳性对照组相比显示出显著差异。
text_zh: 辐照蜂胶日粮处理组与阳性对照组相比显示出显著差异。
text_en: The irradiated propolis diet treatment group showed a significant difference compared to the positive control group.

quote: This study aims to utilize UPLC-Q-TOF/MS metabolomics technology to explore the impact of blocking the glutamate metabolism pathway on the serum metabolites of crucian carp under carbonate alkaline stress.
statement: 本研究旨在利用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS代谢组学技术，探索在碳酸盐碱性胁迫下阻断谷氨酸代谢途径对鲫鱼血清代谢物的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在利用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS代谢组学技术，探索在碳酸盐碱性胁迫下阻断谷氨酸代谢途径对鲫鱼血清代谢物的影响。
text_en: This study aims to use UPLC-Q-TOF/MS metabolomics technology to explore the effects of blocking the glutamate metabolic pathway on serum metabolites in crucian carp under carbonate alkaline stress.

quote: The results showed that ROS imbalances and L-arginine accumulation in crucian carp after the glutamate pathway blockade led to an increase in oxidative stress and inflammatory responses in vivo, which may cause damage to the structure and function of cell membranes.
statement: 谷氨酸通路阻断后，鲫鱼体内的活性氧失衡和L-精氨酸积累导致氧化应激和炎症反应增加，这可能造成细胞膜结构和功能的损伤。
text_zh: 谷氨酸通路阻断后，鲫鱼体内的活性氧失衡和L-精氨酸积累导致氧化应激和炎症反应增加，这可能造成细胞膜结构和功能的损伤。
text_en: After blocking the glutamate pathway, reactive oxygen species imbalance and L-arginine accumulation in crucian carp led to increased oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, which may cause damage to cell membrane structure and function.

quote: Additionally, challenges such as aggravated ammonia excretion obstruction and disrupted energy metabolism were observed in crucian carp, with the upregulation of purine metabolism alleviating ammonia toxicity and maintaining energy homeostasis through pantothenate and CoA biosynthesis as well as fatty acid degradation.
statement: 在鲫鱼中观察到氨排泄障碍加重和能量代谢紊乱等挑战，其中嘌呤代谢的上调通过泛酸和辅酶A生物合成以及脂肪酸降解来缓解氨毒性并维持能量稳态。
text_zh: 在鲫鱼中观察到氨排泄障碍加重和能量代谢紊乱等挑战，其中嘌呤代谢的上调通过泛酸和辅酶A生物合成以及脂肪酸降解来缓解氨毒性并维持能量稳态。
text_en: Challenges such as aggravated ammonia excretion disorders and energy metabolism disturbances were observed in crucian carp, where the upregulation of purine metabolism alleviated ammonia toxicity and maintained energy homeostasis through pantothenate and coenzyme A biosynthesis and fatty acid degradation.

quote:
Water contamination by heavy metals has destructive effects on aquatic organisms and creates
environmental and health problems (Jyoti et al. 2022; Shahjahan et al. 2022).
statement: 重金属对水体的污染对水生生物具有破坏性影响，并造成环境和健康问题。
text_zh: 重金属对水体的污染对水生生物具有破坏性影响，并造成环境和健康问题。
text_en: Heavy metal pollution of water bodies has destructive effects on aquatic organisms and causes environmental and health problems.

quote:
Heavy metals such as
chromium have toxic effects on organisms by producing reactive oxygen species (ROS) that lead to
oxidative stress (Velma & Tchounwou 2013).
statement: 铬等重金属通过产生活性氧（ROS）导致氧化应激，从而对生物体产生毒性作用。
text_zh: 铬等重金属通过产生活性氧（ROS）导致氧化应激，从而对生物体产生毒性作用。
text_en: Heavy metals such as chromium cause toxicity to organisms by generating reactive oxygen species (ROS), leading to oxidative stress.

quote: A total of 540 specimens, with an average weight of 130.67 ± 7.19 g and a body length of 17.83 ± 1.28 cm, were randomly selected and subjected to a two-week acclimation period within indoor recirculating tanks measuring 100 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm.
statement: 实验将540尾鲫鱼随机选取，并在室内循环水箱中进行了为期两周的驯化。
text_zh: 实验将540尾鲫鱼随机选取，并在室内循环水箱中进行了为期两周的驯化。
text_en: The experiment randomly selected 540 crucian carp and conducted a two-week acclimation in indoor recirculating water tanks.

quote: Sulphate water is mainly composed of compounds of sulphate ions (SO 4 2−) and other metal ions, which usually have high levels of acidity, and its toxicity to aquatic organisms is mainly manifested in the damage to gill tissues and the inhibition of enzyme activities
statement: 硫酸盐型水通常酸度较高，其对水生生物的毒性主要表现为对鳃组织的损伤和酶活性的抑制。
text_zh: 硫酸盐型水通常酸度较高，其对水生生物的毒性主要表现为对鳃组织的损伤和酶活性的抑制。
text_en: Sulfate-type water usually has higher acidity, and its toxicity to aquatic organisms mainly manifests as damage to gill tissue and inhibition of enzyme activity.
outcome: 鳃组织损伤与酶活性抑制

quote: The main cations in chloride are sodium and potassium ions, and the anion is chloride, which may affect the osmotic balance and metabolic activities of aquatic organisms at certain concentrations
statement: 氯化物型水中的主要阳离子为钠和钾，阴离子为氯，在一定浓度下可能影响水生生物的渗透平衡和代谢活动。
text_zh: 氯化物型水中的主要阳离子为钠和钾，阴离子为氯，在一定浓度下可能影响水生生物的渗透平衡和代谢活动。
text_en: The main cations in chloride-type water are sodium and potassium, and the anion is chlorine; at certain concentrations, it may affect the osmotic balance and metabolic activities of aquatic organisms.

quote: The high alkalinity of the water can disrupt the mucous cells on the skin surface of fish, affecting their respiratory function.
statement: 水体的高碱度会破坏鱼体表的粘液细胞，进而影响其呼吸功能。
text_zh: 水体的高碱度会破坏鱼体表的粘液细胞，进而影响其呼吸功能。
text_en: High alkalinity in the water body damages the mucus cells on the fish's skin surface, thereby affecting its respiratory function.
outcome: 皮肤粘液细胞完整性与呼吸功能

quote: Additionally, elevated pH values can lead to damage to the gill tissues of fish, influencing the organism’s ion regulation.
statement: 此外，升高的pH值会导致鱼类鳃组织受损，从而影响机体的离子调节。
text_zh: 此外，升高的pH值会导致鱼类鳃组织受损，从而影响机体的离子调节。
text_en: In addition, elevated pH levels cause damage to fish gill tissue, thereby affecting the body's ion regulation.
outcome: 鳃组织损伤与离子调节

quote: Alkaline stress further disrupts the ion permeation balance within fish, affecting osmoregulation
statement: 碱性胁迫进一步破坏鱼体内的离子渗透平衡，影响渗透压调节。
text_zh: 碱性胁迫进一步破坏鱼体内的离子渗透平衡，影响渗透压调节。
text_en: Alkaline stress further disrupts the ionic osmotic balance within fish bodies, affecting osmoregulation.
outcome: 离子渗透平衡与渗透压调节

quote: The exposure of fish to high concentrations of saline–alkaline environments results in a cascade of physiological issues. These include respiratory metabolism disorders [ 8 ], oxidative stress damage to tissues and organs [ 9 ], hindered ammonia excretion [ 10 ], and imbalances in antioxidant and immune systems [ 11 ].
statement: 鱼类暴露于高浓度盐碱环境会导致呼吸代谢紊乱、组织器官氧化应激损伤、氨排泄受阻以及抗氧化和免疫系统失衡等生理问题。
text_zh: 鱼类暴露于高浓度盐碱环境会导致呼吸代谢紊乱、组织器官氧化应激损伤、氨排泄受阻以及抗氧化和免疫系统失衡等生理问题。
text_en: Exposure of fish to high-concentration saline-alkaline environments leads to physiological problems such as respiratory metabolic disorders, oxidative stress damage to tissues and organs, impaired ammonia excretion, and imbalance in antioxidant and immune systems.

quote: These problems significantly affect normal fish growth, development, and reproduction [ 12 ].
statement: 上述生理问题显著影响鱼类的正常生长、发育和繁殖。
text_zh: 上述生理问题显著影响鱼类的正常生长、发育和繁殖。
text_en: The above physiological problems significantly affect the normal growth, development and reproduction of fish.

quote: Consequently, NH 3 accumulates in fish plasma and tissues, leading to ammonia toxicity and potential death [ 13 ].
statement: 因此，NH3在鱼类血浆和组织中积累，导致氨中毒和潜在死亡。
text_zh: 因此，NH3在鱼类血浆和组织中积累，导致氨中毒和潜在死亡。
text_en: Therefore, NH3 accumulates in fish plasma and tissues, leading to ammonia toxicity and potential death.

quote:
in treatment groups 3 and 4, the
amount of chromium reabsorption in the liver and kidneys was significantly reduced compared to the
positive control group.
statement: 与阳性对照组相比，处理组3和4中肝脏和肾脏的铬重吸收量显著减少。
text_zh: 与阳性对照组相比，处理组3和4中肝脏和肾脏的铬重吸收量显著减少。
text_en: Compared to the positive control group, chromium reabsorption in the liver and kidney was significantly reduced in treatment groups 3 and 4.

quote:
Due to gills being exposed to polluted water (Malik et al. 2010), the amount of
toxins in the positive control group is higher than in other tissues according to Table 1.
statement: 由于鳃暴露于受污染的水中，根据表1，阳性对照组中的毒素含量高于其他组织。
text_zh: 由于鳃暴露于受污染的水中，根据表1，阳性对照组中的毒素含量高于其他组织。
text_en: Due to gill exposure to contaminated water, toxin content in the positive control group was higher than in other tissues, according to Table 1.

quote:
Based on this study, the irradiated alcoholic extract propolis can be used to reduce chromium reabsorption in the liver,
kidney, muscle, and gill tissues in the Redfish, significantly.
statement: 基于本研究，辐照酒精提取蜂胶可用于显著减少红鱼肝、肾、肌肉和鳃组织中的铬重吸收。
text_zh: 基于本研究，辐照酒精提取蜂胶可用于显著减少红鱼肝、肾、肌肉和鳃组织中的铬重吸收。
text_en: Based on this study, irradiated alcoholic extract propolis can be used to significantly reduce chromium reabsorption in the liver, kidney, muscle, and gill tissues of red fish.

quote:
Considering the importance of reducing the
adsorption of heavy metals contaminants through aquatic organisms, it should be taken into
consideration that propolis can be used as a suitable alternative feed additive and supplement in fish
diets.
statement: 考虑到通过水生生物减少重金属污染物吸附的重要性，应考虑将蜂胶用作鱼类日粮中合适的替代饲料添加剂和补充剂。
text_zh: 考虑到通过水生生物减少重金属污染物吸附的重要性，应考虑将蜂胶用作鱼类日粮中合适的替代饲料添加剂和补充剂。
text_en: Considering the importance of reducing heavy metal pollutant adsorption through aquatic organisms, propolis should be considered as a suitable alternative feed additive and supplement in fish diets.

quote: The identified DMs were imported into MetaboAnalyst 5.0 to investigate potential metabolic pathways affected in crucian carp serum under saline–alkaline stress following the disruption of the glutamine metabolism pathway.
statement: 研究人员使用MetaboAnalyst 5.0软件分析在盐碱胁迫下谷氨酰胺代谢途径被破坏后鲫鱼血清中受影响的潜在代谢途径。
text_zh: 研究人员使用MetaboAnalyst 5.0软件分析在盐碱胁迫下谷氨酰胺代谢途径被破坏后鲫鱼血清中受影响的潜在代谢途径。
text_en: Researchers used MetaboAnalyst 5.0 software to analyze the affected potential metabolic pathways in crucian carp serum after the glutamine metabolic pathway was disrupted under saline-alkali stress.

quote: Metabolomics, functioning as a tool to intricately link metabolic products with endogenous or exogenous stressors, offers a novel avenue for exploring potential toxic pathways and the adverse effects of environmental exposure on aquatic organisms
statement: 代谢组学作为将代谢产物与内源或外源应激因子联系起来的工具，为探索潜在毒性途径和环境暴露对水生生物的不利影响提供了新途径。
text_zh: 代谢组学作为将代谢产物与内源或外源应激因子联系起来的工具，为探索潜在毒性途径和环境暴露对水生生物的不利影响提供了新途径。
text_en: Metabolomics, as a tool linking metabolites to endogenous or exogenous stress factors, provides new approaches for exploring potential toxicity pathways and the adverse effects of environmental exposure on aquatic organisms.
outcome: 环境暴露的毒性途径及不利影响

quote: Similarly, utilizing metabolomics techniques, Zhang et al. [ 22 ] investigated Eriocheir sinensis and revealed its adaptive strategies to low saline–alkaline stress through the activation of ABC transport proteins and purine metabolism.
statement: Zhang等人利用代谢组学技术研究了中华绒螯蟹，揭示了其通过激活ABC转运蛋白和嘌呤代谢来应对低盐碱胁迫的适应策略。
text_zh: Zhang等人利用代谢组学技术研究了中华绒螯蟹，揭示了其通过激活ABC转运蛋白和嘌呤代谢来应对低盐碱胁迫的适应策略。
text_en: Zhang et al. used metabolomics technology to study the Chinese mitten crab, revealing its adaptive strategy of responding to low salinity-alkalinity stress by activating ABC transporters and purine metabolism.
outcome: 低盐碱胁迫下的适应策略

quote: In contrast, the crabs countered a high amount of saline–alkaline stress through pyrimidine metabolism and β-alanine metabolism.
statement: 相比之下，螃蟹通过嘧啶代谢和β-丙氨酸代谢来对抗高盐碱胁迫。
text_zh: 相比之下，螃蟹通过嘧啶代谢和β-丙氨酸代谢来对抗高盐碱胁迫。
text_en: In contrast, crabs counteract high salinity-alkalinity stress through pyrimidine metabolism and beta-alanine metabolism.
outcome: 高盐碱胁迫下的应对机制

quote: Hypercarbonate saline water has high levels of alkalinity (HCO 3 − and CO 3 2−) and pH, a complex ionic composition, and other physicochemical characteristics, which will not only lead to fish respiratory and metabolic alkalosis, but will also cause a series of physiological problems, such as ammonia excretion obstruction.
statement: 高碳酸盐咸水的高碱度、pH值和复杂离子组成会导致鱼类呼吸性和代谢性碱中毒，并引起氨排泄障碍等生理问题。
text_zh: 高碳酸盐咸水的高碱度、pH值和复杂离子组成会导致鱼类呼吸性和代谢性碱中毒，并引起氨排泄障碍等生理问题。
text_en: The high alkalinity, pH, and complex ion composition of high-carbonate saltwater cause respiratory and metabolic alkalosis in fish, leading to physiological problems such as impaired ammonia excretion.

quote: Ammonia toxicity has been proven to be the main reason why fish cannot adapt to high-saline and -alkaline environments [ 16 ].
statement: 氨毒性已被证明是鱼类无法适应高盐碱环境的主要原因。
text_zh: 氨毒性已被证明是鱼类无法适应高盐碱环境的主要原因。
text_en: Ammonia toxicity has been proven to be the main reason why fish cannot adapt to high salinity-alkalinity environments.

quote: Existing studies indicate that the glutamine metabolism pathway can convert endogenous ammonia into the less toxic glutamine–glutamate, thereby preventing ammonia toxicity.
statement: 现有研究表明，谷氨酰胺代谢途径可以将内源性氨转化为毒性较低的谷氨酰胺-谷氨酸，从而防止氨毒性。
text_zh: 现有研究表明，谷氨酰胺代谢途径可以将内源性氨转化为毒性较低的谷氨酰胺-谷氨酸，从而防止氨毒性。
text_en: Existing research indicates that the glutamine metabolic pathway can convert endogenous ammonia into less toxic glutamine-glutamate, thereby preventing ammonia toxicity.

quote: This study aimed to elucidate the impact mechanisms of the disruption of the glutamate pathway on serum metabolism and ammonia excretion in crucian carp (Carassius auratus) under carbonate alkaline stress.
statement: 本研究旨在阐明碳酸盐碱胁迫下谷氨酸通路阻断对鲫鱼血清代谢和氨排泄的影响机制。
text_zh: 本研究旨在阐明碳酸盐碱胁迫下谷氨酸通路阻断对鲫鱼血清代谢和氨排泄的影响机制。
text_en: This study aims to elucidate the mechanism by which glutamate pathway blockade affects serum metabolism and ammonia excretion in crucian carp under carbonate alkaline stress.

quote: A freshwater control group (C group), a 20 mmol/L NaHCO 3 stress group (L group), and a 40 mmol/L NaHCO 3 stress group (H group) were established.
statement: 建立了淡水对照组（C组）、20 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组（L组）和40 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组（H组）。
text_zh: 建立了淡水对照组（C组）、20 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组（L组）和40 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组（H组）。
text_en: A freshwater control group (Group C), a 20 mmol/L NaHCO3 stress group (Group L), and a 40 mmol/L NaHCO3 stress group (Group H) were established.

quote: The results revealed that blocking the glutamine metabolism pathway induced oxidative stress and inflammatory responses in crucian carp, leading to disturbances in their lipid metabolism and amino acid synthesis.
statement: 结果揭示阻断谷氨酰胺代谢通路会诱导鲫鱼产生氧化应激和炎症反应，导致其脂质代谢和氨基酸合成紊乱。
text_zh: 结果揭示阻断谷氨酰胺代谢通路会诱导鲫鱼产生氧化应激和炎症反应，导致其脂质代谢和氨基酸合成紊乱。
text_en: The results revealed that blocking the glutamine metabolic pathway induced oxidative stress and inflammatory responses in crucian carp, leading to disturbances in their lipid metabolism and amino acid synthesis.

quote: Another study demonstrated that goldfish’s SOD levels in the kidney increased when exposed to hexavalent chromium.
statement: 另一项研究表明，当暴露于六价铬时，金鱼肾脏中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平增加。
text_zh: 另一项研究表明，当暴露于六价铬时，金鱼肾脏中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平增加。
text_en: Another study showed that when exposed to hexavalent chromium, superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels in the kidneys of goldfish increased.

quote: Exposure to the same mode of chromium decreased CAT levels in the kidney.
statement: 暴露于相同形式的铬导致肾脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）水平降低。
text_zh: 暴露于相同形式的铬导致肾脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）水平降低。
text_en: Exposure to the same form of chromium led to decreased catalase (CAT) levels in the kidney.

quote: GST levels also showed a decrease in the kidney with exposure to trivalent chromium (Kubrak et al. 2010).
statement: 暴露于三价铬也导致肾脏中谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶（GST）水平下降。
text_zh: 暴露于三价铬也导致肾脏中谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶（GST）水平下降。
text_en: Exposure to trivalent chromium also led to a decrease in glutathione-S-transferase (GST) levels in the kidney.

quote: Goldfish were exposed to chromium in the concentration range of 4 ppm, 6 ppm, 8 ppm, and 12 ppm for 96 hours, which showed several morphological and behavioural changes.
statement: 金鱼在4、6、8和12 ppm的浓度范围内暴露于铬96小时，显示出多种形态和行为变化。
text_zh: 金鱼在4、6、8和12 ppm的浓度范围内暴露于铬96小时，显示出多种形态和行为变化。
text_en: Goldfish exposed to chromium for 96 hours at concentrations of 4, 6, 8 and 12 ppm showed various morphological and behavioral changes.

quote: Li et al. (2015) showed that the gills, intestines, and liver contained the most hexavalent chromium in Oryzias latipes exposed to 17.1 mg/L Cr6+ for 6 days (Li et al. 2015).
statement: Li等人（2015年）表明，暴露于17.1 mg/L六价铬6天的青鳉鱼中，鳃、肠道和肝脏含有最多的六价铬。
text_zh: Li等人（2015年）表明，暴露于17.1 mg/L六价铬6天的青鳉鱼中，鳃、肠道和肝脏含有最多的六价铬。
text_en: Li et al. (2015) showed that in medaka fish exposed to 17.1 mg/L hexavalent chromium for 6 days, the gills, intestine, and liver contained the most hexavalent chromium.

quote: The liver and kidneys are the main storage and detoxification organs for most toxins (Vinodhini & Narayanan 2008), in which high levels of hexavalent chromium were observed (Palaniappan & Karthikeyan 2009).
statement: 肝脏和肾脏是大多数毒素的主要储存和解毒器官，其中观察到高水平的六价铬。
text_zh: 肝脏和肾脏是大多数毒素的主要储存和解毒器官，其中观察到高水平的六价铬。
text_en: The liver and kidneys are the main storage and detoxification organs for most toxins, where high levels of hexavalent chromium were observed.

quote: During the experimental period, the daily feeding rate was approximately 3% of the fish body weight, with feeding conducted twice a day at 8:30 and 17:30.
statement: 实验期间，日投喂率约为鱼体重的3%，每天于8:30和17:30投喂两次。
text_zh: 实验期间，日投喂率约为鱼体重的3%，每天于8:30和17:30投喂两次。
text_en: During the experimental period, the daily feeding rate was about 3% of body weight, with two feedings per day at 8:30 and 17:30.

quote: After each feeding session lasting 30 min, residual feed and feces were promptly removed to prevent water quality contamination.
statement: 每次投喂持续30分钟后，及时清除残饵和粪便以防止水质污染。
text_zh: 每次投喂持续30分钟后，及时清除残饵和粪便以防止水质污染。
text_en: After each feeding lasts for 30 minutes, promptly remove leftover feed and feces to prevent water quality pollution.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at around (24 ± 1.0) °C.
statement: 水温维持在(24 ± 1.0) °C左右。
text_zh: 水温维持在(24 ± 1.0) °C左右。
text_en: The water temperature was maintained at about (24 ± 1.0) °C.

quote: Ammonium nitrogen levels were kept below 1.0 mg/L, and dissolved oxygen levels were maintained above 7.5 mg/L.
statement: 氨氮水平保持在1.0 mg/L以下，溶解氧水平维持在7.5 mg/L以上。
text_zh: 氨氮水平保持在1.0 mg/L以下，溶解氧水平维持在7.5 mg/L以上。
text_en: Ammonia nitrogen levels are kept below 1.0 mg/L, and dissolved oxygen levels are maintained above 7.5 mg/L.

quote: A partial water change of one-third of the total volume was performed every 3 days, and NaHCO 3 was supplemented as needed to sustain the experimental concentration (as determined by acid–base titration method for NaHCO 3 concentration).
statement: 每3天更换三分之一的水量，并根据需要补充NaHCO3以维持实验浓度（通过酸碱滴定法测定NaHCO3浓度）。
text_zh: 每3天更换三分之一的水量，并根据需要补充NaHCO3以维持实验浓度（通过酸碱滴定法测定NaHCO3浓度）。
text_en: One-third of the water volume is replaced every 3 days, and NaHCO3 is supplemented as needed to maintain the experimental concentration (NaHCO3 concentration determined by acid-base titration).

quote: After anesthesia with 100 mg/L MS-222, blood was collected from the caudal vein using a sterile 5 mL syringe, transferred to a centrifuge tube, and allowed to stand at 4 °C for 2 h.
statement: 使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉后，用无菌5 mL注射器从尾静脉采血，转移至离心管并在4°C下静置2小时。
text_zh: 使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉后，用无菌5 mL注射器从尾静脉采血，转移至离心管并在4°C下静置2小时。
text_en: After anesthesia with 100 mg/L MS-222, blood was collected from the caudal vein using a sterile 5 mL syringe, transferred to centrifuge tubes, and left to stand at 4°C for 2 hours.

quote: Studies on Scophthalmus maximus under high-temperature stress at 24 °C have shown that glycerophospholipid metabolism is significantly affected, with a decrease in PC content.
statement: 高温胁迫（24°C）显著影响大菱鲆的甘油磷脂代谢，导致PC含量降低。
text_zh: 高温胁迫（24°C）显著影响大菱鲆的甘油磷脂代谢，导致PC含量降低。
text_en: High temperature stress (24°C) significantly affects glycerophospholipid metabolism in turbot, leading to a decrease in PC content.
outcome: 细胞膜完整性与脂质代谢

quote: This suggests that the flatfish regulates genes and metabolites related to lipid metabolism to maintain membrane balance, inhibit lipid deposition, and alleviate meat deterioration caused by high-temperature stress [ 36 ].
statement: 这表明大菱鲆通过调节脂质代谢相关基因和代谢物来维持膜平衡、抑制脂质沉积并缓解高温胁迫引起的肉质劣变。
text_zh: 这表明大菱鲆通过调节脂质代谢相关基因和代谢物来维持膜平衡、抑制脂质沉积并缓解高温胁迫引起的肉质劣变。
text_en: This indicates that turbot maintains membrane balance, inhibits lipid deposition, and alleviates high-temperature stress-induced deterioration of flesh quality by regulating genes and metabolites related to lipid metabolism.

quote: Additionally, research on Scatophagus argus under salt stress found that both high and low amounts of salt stress led to a significant downregulation of genes (cept1 and pla2g4a) associated with glycerophospholipid metabolism.
statement: 此外，对金钱鱼在盐度胁迫下的研究发现，高和低盐度胁迫均导致与甘油磷脂代谢相关的基因（cept1和pla2g4a）显著下调。
text_zh: 此外，对金钱鱼在盐度胁迫下的研究发现，高和低盐度胁迫均导致与甘油磷脂代谢相关的基因（cept1和pla2g4a）显著下调。
text_en: In addition, a study on Scatophagus argus under salinity stress found that both high and low salinity stress led to significant downregulation of genes related to glycerophospholipid metabolism (cept1 and pla2g4a).

quote: This indicates a reduced efficiency in the conversion of phosphatidylserine, and changes in cell membrane structure and energy storage may occur for the organism to adapt to different salinity conditions [ 37 ].
statement: 这表明磷脂酰丝氨酸转化效率降低，且生物体可能通过改变细胞膜结构和能量储存以适应不同的盐度条件。
text_zh: 这表明磷脂酰丝氨酸转化效率降低，且生物体可能通过改变细胞膜结构和能量储存以适应不同的盐度条件。
text_en: This indicates that phosphatidylserine conversion efficiency is reduced, and the organism may adapt to different salinity conditions by altering cell membrane structure and energy storage.
outcome: 细胞膜结构与能量稳态

quote: Research indicates that under highly saline–alkaline environmental stress, crucian carp (Carassius auratus) experience a significant increase in blood ammonia concentration, coupled with hindered ammonia excretion.
statement: 研究表明，在高盐碱环境胁迫下，鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）血氨浓度显著升高，且氨排泄受阻。
text_zh: 研究表明，在高盐碱环境胁迫下，鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）血氨浓度显著升高，且氨排泄受阻。
text_en: Studies show that under high salinity-alkalinity environmental stress, the blood ammonia concentration of crucian carp (Carassius auratus) increases significantly, and ammonia excretion is hindered.

quote: In the case of acute carbonate alkaline stress, Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) reach a peak blood ammonia concentration after 12 h and regulate it through the glutamate metabolism pathway [ 17 ].
statement: 在急性碳酸盐碱性胁迫下，尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）在12小时后达到血氨浓度峰值，并通过谷氨酸代谢途径进行调节。
text_zh: 在急性碳酸盐碱性胁迫下，尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）在12小时后达到血氨浓度峰值，并通过谷氨酸代谢途径进行调节。
text_en: Under acute carbonate alkaline stress, Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) reached peak blood ammonia concentration after 12 hours and regulated it through the glutamate metabolic pathway.

quote: Current research indicates that under ammonia stress, the expression of most genes associated with the purine metabolism pathway in L. vannamei , including the XDH gene, a key enzyme in purine metabolism, is significantly downregulated.
statement: 现有研究表明，在氨胁迫下，凡纳滨对虾中与嘌呤代谢途径相关的大多数基因（包括关键酶XDH基因）的表达显著下调。
text_zh: 现有研究表明，在氨胁迫下，凡纳滨对虾中与嘌呤代谢途径相关的大多数基因（包括关键酶XDH基因）的表达显著下调。
text_en: Existing research shows that under ammonia stress, the expression of most genes related to the purine metabolism pathway (including the key enzyme XDH gene) in Litopenaeus vannamei is significantly downregulated.
outcome: 氨胁迫下的基因表达与代谢反应

quote: The purine metabolism of Coilianasus was disturbed under ammonia stress, and the expression of genes related to purine metabolism was significantly suppressed, which reduced the effects of ammonia stress by decreasing the purine metabolism, even though the inflammatory response caused by ammonia stress still existed up to 24 h after the freshwater recovered [ 60 ].
statement: Coilianasus在氨胁迫下嘌呤代谢受到干扰，相关基因表达显著抑制，通过降低嘌呤代谢减轻了氨胁迫的影响，尽管氨胁迫引起的炎症反应在恢复淡水后仍持续存在长达24小时。
text_zh: Coilianasus在氨胁迫下嘌呤代谢受到干扰，相关基因表达显著抑制，通过降低嘌呤代谢减轻了氨胁迫的影响，尽管氨胁迫引起的炎症反应在恢复淡水后仍持续存在长达24小时。
text_en: Purine metabolism in Coilianasus is disrupted under ammonia stress, with significant suppression of related gene expression; reducing purine metabolism alleviates the effects of ammonia stress, although the inflammatory response induced by ammonia stress persists for up to 24 hours after recovery in freshwater.
outcome: 氨胁迫后的炎症反应持续时间
counterevidence: 炎症反应在恢复淡水后仍持续存在长达24小时

quote: Feeding was suspended post-injection, and samples were collected 96 h later.
statement: 注射后停止喂食，并在96小时后采集样本。
text_zh: 注射后停止喂食，并在96小时后采集样本。
text_en: Feeding was stopped after injection, and samples were collected 96 hours later.

quote: The NaHCO 3 exposure groups were gradually elevated to the experimental concentration at a daily rate of 5 mmol/L.
statement: NaHCO3暴露组的浓度以每天5 mmol/L的速度逐渐升高至实验浓度。
text_zh: NaHCO3暴露组的浓度以每天5 mmol/L的速度逐渐升高至实验浓度。
text_en: The concentration in the NaHCO3 exposure group was gradually increased to the experimental concentration at a rate of 5 mmol/L per day.

quote: This aligns closely with the findings of Ding et al. [ 50 ], who reported similar disruptions in sphingolipid metabolism and apoptosis induction in crucian carp under saline–alkaline stress.
statement: 这与Ding等人[50]的发现一致，他们报道了盐碱胁迫下鲫鱼中类似的鞘脂代谢紊乱和细胞凋亡诱导。
text_zh: 这与Ding等人[50]的发现一致，他们报道了盐碱胁迫下鲫鱼中类似的鞘脂代谢紊乱和细胞凋亡诱导。
text_en: This is consistent with the findings of Ding et al. [50], who reported similar sphingolipid metabolic disorders and induction of apoptosis in crucian carp under saline-alkali stress.

quote: Gao et al. investigated the physiological changes in gill tissues of Coilianasus under salt stress and found that the proline metabolic pathway was activated in order to resist salt stress as a way to improve its low salt tolerance [ 53 ].
statement: Gao等人研究了盐胁迫下Coilianasus鳃组织的生理变化，发现脯氨酸代谢通路被激活以抵抗盐胁迫，从而改善其低耐盐性[53]。
text_zh: Gao等人研究了盐胁迫下Coilianasus鳃组织的生理变化，发现脯氨酸代谢通路被激活以抵抗盐胁迫，从而改善其低耐盐性[53]。
text_en: Gao et al. studied the physiological changes in the gill tissue of Coilianasus under salt stress and found that the proline metabolic pathway was activated to resist salt stress, thereby improving its low salt tolerance [53].

quote: Moreover, it is closely linked to oxidative stress, which can arise from the production of substantial amounts of reactive oxygen species [ 38 ].
statement: 此外，它与氧化应激密切相关，氧化应激可能源于大量活性氧的产生。
text_zh: 此外，它与氧化应激密切相关，氧化应激可能源于大量活性氧的产生。
text_en: In addition, it is closely related to oxidative stress, which may result from the production of large amounts of reactive oxygen species.

quote: Typically, oxidative stress causes inflammation to occur [ 39 ].
statement: 通常，氧化应激会导致炎症发生。
text_zh: 通常，氧化应激会导致炎症发生。
text_en: Usually, oxidative stress leads to inflammation.

quote: Moreover, it was possible to alleviate the phenomenon of ammonia toxicity by activating the purine metabolism to increase nitrogen-containing waste excretion in the body.
statement: 此外，通过激活嘌呤代谢以增加体内含氮废物的排泄，有可能缓解氨中毒现象。
text_zh: 此外，通过激活嘌呤代谢以增加体内含氮废物的排泄，有可能缓解氨中毒现象。
text_en: In addition, by activating purine metabolism to increase the excretion of nitrogenous waste in the body, it is possible to alleviate ammonia toxicity.

quote: Dong et al. characterized the physiological and metabolic changes in Macrobrachiumrosenbergii under ammonia stress and showed that high levels of environmental ammonia stress increased the body’s glutamate and arginine levels, and these two amino acids may be involved in the urea cycle to synthesize glutamine or urea to eliminate ammonia toxicity [ 54 ].
statement: Dong等人发现，高浓度的环境氨胁迫会增加罗氏沼虾体内的谷氨酸和精氨酸水平，这两种氨基酸可能参与尿素循环以合成谷氨酰胺或尿素来消除氨毒性。
text_zh: Dong等人发现，高浓度的环境氨胁迫会增加罗氏沼虾体内的谷氨酸和精氨酸水平，这两种氨基酸可能参与尿素循环以合成谷氨酰胺或尿素来消除氨毒性。
text_en: Dong et al. found that high concentrations of environmental ammonia stress increased glutamate and arginine levels in Macrobrachium rosenbergii; these two amino acids may participate in the urea cycle to synthesize glutamine or urea to eliminate ammonia toxicity.

quote: Recent research by Zhao et al. [ 42 ] demonstrated significant changes in the expression levels of genes involved in arachidonic acid metabolism in the gills and kidneys of Leuciscus waleckii under highly alkaline conditions, leading to the generation of an immune response.
statement: Zhao等人[42]的研究表明，在强碱性条件下，Leuciscus waleckii鳃和肾脏中与花生四烯酸代谢相关的基因表达水平发生显著变化，导致免疫反应的产生。
text_zh: Zhao等人[42]的研究表明，在强碱性条件下，Leuciscus waleckii鳃和肾脏中与花生四烯酸代谢相关的基因表达水平发生显著变化，导致免疫反应的产生。
text_en: A study by Zhao et al. [42] showed that under strongly alkaline conditions, the expression levels of genes related to arachidonic acid metabolism in the gills and kidneys of Leuciscus waleckii changed significantly, leading to an immune response.

quote: Similarly, under carbonate saline–alkaline stress, the disruption of arachidonic acid metabolism in the liver of crucian carp resulted in a significant increase in the concentration of metabolites closely related to arachidonic acid metabolism, leading to inflammation in the crucian carp’s liver cells [ 43 ].
statement: 同样，在碳酸盐碱胁迫下，鲫鱼肝脏中花生四烯酸代谢的紊乱导致与花生四烯酸代谢密切相关的代谢物浓度显著增加，进而引起鲫鱼肝细胞炎症[43]。
text_zh: 同样，在碳酸盐碱胁迫下，鲫鱼肝脏中花生四烯酸代谢的紊乱导致与花生四烯酸代谢密切相关的代谢物浓度显著增加，进而引起鲫鱼肝细胞炎症[43]。
text_en: Similarly, under carbonate alkaline stress, the disorder of arachidonic acid metabolism in the liver of crucian carp leads to a significant increase in the concentration of metabolites closely related to arachidonic acid metabolism, thereby causing inflammation in crucian carp hepatocytes [43].

quote: Our study found that metabolites related to immune and inflammatory responses, such as arachidonic acid and leukotriene A4 (LTA4), were significantly enriched in the MH group.
statement: 本研究发现，与免疫和炎症反应相关的代谢物（如花生四烯酸和白三烯A4）在MH组中显著富集。
text_zh: 本研究发现，与免疫和炎症反应相关的代谢物（如花生四烯酸和白三烯A4）在MH组中显著富集。
text_en: This study found that metabolites related to immune and inflammatory responses (such as arachidonic acid and leukotriene A4) were significantly enriched in the MH group.

quote: Under heat stress conditions, Oncorhynchus mykiss activated the glutamate–glutamine metabolic pathway to respond to oxidative damage caused by heat stress [ 46 ].
statement: 在高温胁迫条件下，虹鳟(Oncorhynchus mykiss)激活了谷氨酸-谷氨酰胺代谢途径以应对高温胁迫引起的氧化损伤[46]。
text_zh: 在高温胁迫条件下，虹鳟(Oncorhynchus mykiss)激活了谷氨酸-谷氨酰胺代谢途径以应对高温胁迫引起的氧化损伤[46]。
text_en: Under high-temperature stress conditions, rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) activated the glutamate-glutamine metabolic pathway to cope with oxidative damage caused by high-temperature stress [46].

quote: This study revealed that the blockage of the glutamate metabolic pathway disrupted lipid metabolism, including glycerophospholipid metabolism, arachidonic acid metabolism, and sphingolipid metabolism, leading to the development of an inflammatory response in crucian carp.
statement: 阻断谷氨酸代谢途径会破坏脂质代谢，导致鲫鱼产生炎症反应。
text_zh: 阻断谷氨酸代谢途径会破坏脂质代谢，导致鲫鱼产生炎症反应。
text_en: Blocking the glutamate metabolic pathway disrupts lipid metabolism, leading to an inflammatory response in crucian carp.
outcome: 炎症反应与脂质代谢紊乱

quote: The crucian carp responded by upregulating their purine metabolism to alleviate the ammonia toxicity.
statement: 鲫鱼通过上调嘌呤代谢来缓解氨毒性。
text_zh: 鲫鱼通过上调嘌呤代谢来缓解氨毒性。
text_en: Crucian carp alleviate ammonia toxicity by upregulating purine metabolism.

quote: Red crucian carp was anesthetized before decapitation
statement: 红鲫在断头前进行了麻醉处理。
text_zh: 红鲫在断头前进行了麻醉处理。
text_en: Red crucian carp were anesthetized before decapitation.
outcome: 屠宰/安乐死过程中的应激控制

quote: A study by Zhang et al. [ 65 ] on the effects of the water flow rate stress on the liver of Trachinotus ovatus through metabolomics revealed that, compared to the static water group, both the medium-flow and high-flow groups showed an increase in the pantothenic acid content.
statement: Zhang等人通过代谢组学研究发现，与静水组相比，中流速和高流速组的卵形鲳鲹肝脏泛酸含量增加。
text_zh: Zhang等人通过代谢组学研究发现，与静水组相比，中流速和高流速组的卵形鲳鲹肝脏泛酸含量增加。
text_en: Zhang et al. found through metabolomics research that, compared with the still-water group, the pantothenic acid content in the liver of Trachinotus ovatus increased in the medium-flow and high-flow groups.

quote: This suggested that flow rate stress promotes the TCA cycle in the liver of ovate pomfret, providing energy for their movement through enhanced aerobic respiration.
statement: 这表明流速胁迫促进了卵形鲳鲹肝脏中的三羧酸循环，通过增强有氧呼吸为其运动提供能量。
text_zh: 这表明流速胁迫促进了卵形鲳鲹肝脏中的三羧酸循环，通过增强有氧呼吸为其运动提供能量。
text_en: This indicates that flow velocity stress promoted the tricarboxylic acid cycle in the liver of Trachinotus ovatus, providing energy for its movement by enhancing aerobic respiration.

quote: Environmental stress can accelerate fat breakdown, providing free fatty acids as a primary source of energy for fish metabolism [ 67 ].
statement: 环境胁迫可以加速脂肪分解，为鱼类代谢提供游离脂肪酸作为主要能量来源。
text_zh: 环境胁迫可以加速脂肪分解，为鱼类代谢提供游离脂肪酸作为主要能量来源。
text_en: Environmental stress can accelerate fat breakdown, providing free fatty acids as a major energy source for fish metabolism.

quote: Pieces of skin tissue were surgically excised from RCC and WCC, being anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich) before dissection.
statement: 在解剖前，使用100 mg/L的MS-222对红体色和白色鲫鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在解剖前，使用100 mg/L的MS-222对红体色和白色鲫鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Before dissection, red and white crucian carp were anesthetized using 100 mg/L MS-222.

quote: All the sampling procedures were conducted according to the standards and ethical guidelines established by the Animal Ethical Review Committee of Hunan Normal University, Changsha, China.
statement: 所有采样程序均遵循湖南师范大学动物伦理审查委员会制定的标准和伦理指南。
text_zh: 所有采样程序均遵循湖南师范大学动物伦理审查委员会制定的标准和伦理指南。
text_en: All sampling procedures followed the standards and ethical guidelines established by the Animal Ethics Review Committee of Hunan Normal University.

quote: s have shown that fatty acid anabolism and catabolism, including fatty acid elongation, fatty acid degradation, unsaturated fatty acid biosynthesis, and fatty acid β-oxidation, are activated in several tissues, including intestine, hepatopancreas, and muscle, in Gymnocypris przewalskii from Qinghai Lake under cold stress, suggesting that the naked carp dependently utilize fatty acids as an energy primary source [ 68 ].
statement: 已有研究表明，在冷应激下，青海湖裸鲤的多个组织（包括肠道、肝胰腺和肌肉）中脂肪酸合成与分解代谢被激活，提示其依赖利用脂肪酸作为主要能量来源。
text_zh: 已有研究表明，在冷应激下，青海湖裸鲤的多个组织（包括肠道、肝胰腺和肌肉）中脂肪酸合成与分解代谢被激活，提示其依赖利用脂肪酸作为主要能量来源。
text_en: Existing studies have shown that under cold stress, fatty acid synthesis and catabolism are activated in multiple tissues (including the intestine, hepatopancreas, and muscle) of Qinghai Lake naked carp, suggesting that they rely on fatty acids as a primary energy source.

quote: Another study demonstrated that under crowding stress, immune indicators in hybrid sturgeon (♀ Acipenser baerii × ♂ Acipenser schrenckii) did not show significant changes. However, pathways related to fatty acid degradation, gluconeogenesis, and glycogen breakdown were significantly activated to account for the increased energy expenditure in sturgeon under crowding stress [ 69 ].
statement: 另一项研究表明，在拥挤应激下，杂交鲟的免疫指标未显示显著变化，但与脂肪酸降解、糖异生和糖原分解相关的通路被显著激活，以应对能量消耗增加。
text_zh: 另一项研究表明，在拥挤应激下，杂交鲟的免疫指标未显示显著变化，但与脂肪酸降解、糖异生和糖原分解相关的通路被显著激活，以应对能量消耗增加。
text_en: Another study showed that under crowding stress, immune indicators of hybrid sturgeon did not show significant changes, but pathways related to fatty acid degradation, gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis were significantly activated to cope with increased energy consumption.
counterevidence: 免疫指标未显示显著变化

quote: Spermidine plays an important role in glutathione metabolism; in particular, under oxidative stress conditions, spermidine can inhibit glutathione enzyme activity, which reduces glutathione catabolism and protects cells from oxidative stress and inflammatory damage [ 47 ].
statement: 亚精胺在谷胱甘肽代谢中起重要作用；特别是在氧化应激条件下，亚精胺可以抑制谷胱甘肽酶活性，从而减少谷胱甘肽分解代谢并保护细胞免受氧化应激和炎症损伤。
text_zh: 亚精胺在谷胱甘肽代谢中起重要作用；特别是在氧化应激条件下，亚精胺可以抑制谷胱甘肽酶活性，从而减少谷胱甘肽分解代谢并保护细胞免受氧化应激和炎症损伤。
text_en: Spermidine plays an important role in glutathione metabolism; specifically, under oxidative stress conditions, spermidine can inhibit glutathione enzyme activity, thereby reducing glutathione catabolism and protecting cells from oxidative stress and inflammatory damage.

quote: In addition, we could inhibit the catabolism of glutathione enzyme and reduce the oxidative stress damage in crucian carp by increasing the concentration of spermidine.
statement: 此外，通过增加亚精胺浓度可以抑制谷胱甘肽酶的分解代谢并减轻鲫鱼的氧化应激损伤。
text_zh: 此外，通过增加亚精胺浓度可以抑制谷胱甘肽酶的分解代谢并减轻鲫鱼的氧化应激损伤。
text_en: In addition, increasing spermidine concentration can inhibit the catabolism of glutathione enzymes and alleviate oxidative stress damage in crucian carp.

quote: All individuals were fed in the tanks (height is 86 cm, diameter is 101 cm) with the same environment and fed twice a day at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
statement: 所有个体在相同环境的特定尺寸水箱中饲养，并每天上午9点和下午5点喂食两次。
text_zh: 所有个体在相同环境的特定尺寸水箱中饲养，并每天上午9点和下午5点喂食两次。
text_en: All individuals were reared in specific-sized tanks under the same environment and fed twice daily at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.

quote: For this experiment, 6-month-old WT (n = 18, 10.28 ± 2.18 g), mc3r +/− (n = 18, 10.38 ± 2.27 g), and mc4r +/− (n = 18, 16.80 ± 4.68 g) fish were individually placed into nine tanks (six fish each) with the same feeding environment, and each type of fish was divided into three replicates.
statement: 实验将6个月大的野生型、mc3r杂合子和mc4r杂合子鱼分别单独放入九个水箱（每箱六条），具有相同的饲养环境，每种类型的鱼分为三个重复组。
text_zh: 实验将6个月大的野生型、mc3r杂合子和mc4r杂合子鱼分别单独放入九个水箱（每箱六条），具有相同的饲养环境，每种类型的鱼分为三个重复组。
text_en: The experiment placed 6-month-old wild-type, mc3r heterozygous, and mc4r heterozygous fish separately into nine tanks (six fish per tank), with the same rearing environment, dividing each type of fish into three replicate groups.

quote: The fish were fed once a day.
statement: 鱼类每天喂食一次。
text_zh: 鱼类每天喂食一次。
text_en: Fish are fed once a day.

quote: Food intake was calculated as the difference between the initial dry weight and residual dry weight.
statement: 食物摄入量通过初始干重与剩余干重之差计算得出。
text_zh: 食物摄入量通过初始干重与剩余干重之差计算得出。
text_en: Food intake was calculated as the difference between initial dry weight and remaining dry weight.

quote: In rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), Schjolden et al. reported that MC4R could regulate the food intake in 2008 (19).
statement: 在虹鳟中，Schjolden等人报道MC4R可以调节食物摄入量。
text_zh: 在虹鳟中，Schjolden等人报道MC4R可以调节食物摄入量。
text_en: In rainbow trout, Schjolden et al. reported that MC4R can regulate food intake.

quote: The diameter of the inhibition zone was measured to determine the antimicrobial susceptibil- ity or resistance, and the criteria were as follows: inhibition zone diameter (Φ) ≥15 mm indicates high sensitivity (S), 15 mm > Φ ≥ 10 mm shows intermedi- ate sensitivity (I), Φ < 10 mm indicates resistance (R).
statement: 通过测量抑菌圈直径来确定抗菌药物的敏感性或耐药性，标准如下：抑菌圈直径≥15毫米表示高敏感，15毫米>直径≥10毫米表示中等敏感，直径<10毫米表示耐药。
text_zh: 通过测量抑菌圈直径来确定抗菌药物的敏感性或耐药性，标准如下：抑菌圈直径≥15毫米表示高敏感，15毫米>直径≥10毫米表示中等敏感，直径<10毫米表示耐药。
text_en: The sensitivity or resistance to antimicrobial drugs is determined by measuring the diameter of the inhibition zone, with the following standards: an inhibition zone diameter ≥15 mm indicates high sensitivity, 15 mm > diameter ≥10 mm indicates moderate sensitivity, and a diameter <10 mm indicates resistance.

quote: No clinical signs were observed in the control fish.
statement: 在对照鱼中未观察到临床症状。
text_zh: 在对照鱼中未观察到临床症状。
text_en: No clinical signs were observed in the control fish.

quote: Of the antibiotics/concentra-tions tested, the isolate was highly susceptible to chloramphenicol, both macrolides, 3 quinolones, and 2/3 aminoglycosides (exception: netilmicin), but resistant to all 6 cephalosporins, all 3 sulphonamides, 2/3 penicillins (exception: piperacillin), and all other antibiotics in the panel
statement: 测试的分离株对氯霉素、大环内酯类、喹诺酮类和部分氨基糖苷类高度敏感，但对头孢菌素、磺胺类、部分青霉素及其他抗生素耐药。
text_zh: 测试的分离株对氯霉素、大环内酯类、喹诺酮类和部分氨基糖苷类高度敏感，但对头孢菌素、磺胺类、部分青霉素及其他抗生素耐药。
text_en: The tested isolates were highly sensitive to chloramphenicol, macrolides, quinolones and some aminoglycosides, but resistant to cephalosporins, sulfonamides, some penicillins and other antibiotics.
outcome: 疾病治疗与药物敏感性

quote: Experimental challenges were conducted which demonstrated pathogenicity of the isolate in crucian carp.
statement: 通过人工感染实验证实了该分离株对鲫鱼的致病性。
text_zh: 通过人工感染实验证实了该分离株对鲫鱼的致病性。
text_en: The pathogenicity of this isolate to crucian carp was confirmed by artificial infection experiments.

quote: Antimicrobial susceptibility test- ing showed that the isolated strain was susceptible to piperacillin, gentamicin, kanamycin, nali - dixic acid, norfloxacin, ofloxacin, azithromycin and erythr
statement: 药敏试验显示，该分离菌株对哌拉西林、庆大霉素、卡那霉素、萘啶酸、诺氟沙星、氧氟沙星、阿奇霉素和红霉素敏感。
text_zh: 药敏试验显示，该分离菌株对哌拉西林、庆大霉素、卡那霉素、萘啶酸、诺氟沙星、氧氟沙星、阿奇霉素和红霉素敏感。
text_en: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing showed that the isolated strain was sensitive to piperacillin, gentamicin, kanamycin, nalidixic acid, norfloxacin, ofloxacin, azithromycin and erythromycin.

quote: A 12:12 h light:dark period was maintained, and fish were fed with commercial feed (Tongwei) once daily.
statement: 维持12小时光照和12小时黑暗周期，并每天投喂一次商业饲料。
text_zh: 维持12小时光照和12小时黑暗周期，并每天投喂一次商业饲料。
text_en: Maintain a 12-hour light and 12-hour dark cycle, and feed commercial feed once daily.

quote: Water was replaced daily and main-tained at 26 ± 2°C.
statement: 每天换水并将水温维持在26±2°C。
text_zh: 每天换水并将水温维持在26±2°C。
text_en: Water was changed daily and the water temperature was maintained at 26±2°C.
intervention: Daily water change and temperature control

quote: The occurrence of infections by opportunistic pa - thogens has become an increasingly important health problem for farmed fish in China
statement: 机会性病原体感染已成为中国养殖鱼类日益重要的健康问题。
text_zh: 机会性病原体感染已成为中国养殖鱼类日益重要的健康问题。
text_en: Infections by opportunistic pathogens have become an increasingly important health problem for farmed fish in China.

ease,

text_en: In this study, the KCL-5 strain was isolated from farmed crucian carp exhibiting clinical disease symptoms.
