statement: 进行了抗菌药物敏感性试验以确定...
text_zh: 进行了抗菌药物敏感性试验以确定...
text_en: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed to determine...

quote: The typical clinical signs were skin haemorrhages, mainly located on the pectoral fin base, caudal fin and parts of the body.
statement: 典型的临床症状为皮肤出血，主要位于胸鳍基部、尾鳍和身体部分区域。
text_zh: 典型的临床症状为皮肤出血，主要位于胸鳍基部、尾鳍和身体部分区域。
text_en: Typical clinical symptoms are skin hemorrhage, mainly located at the base of the pectoral fins, the tail fin, and parts of the body.

quote: Mortality levels of ∼40% were found in the naturally infected fish.
statement: 在自然感染的鱼中发现了约40%的死亡率。
text_zh: 在自然感染的鱼中发现了约40%的死亡率。
text_en: A mortality rate of about 40% was found in naturally infected fish.

quote: The isolate KCL-5 was confirmed as pathogenic to crucian carp by challenge experiments.
statement: 通过攻毒实验证实分离株KCL-5对鲫鱼具有致病性。
text_zh: 通过攻毒实验证实分离株KCL-5对鲫鱼具有致病性。
text_en: Challenge experiments confirmed that isolate KCL-5 is pathogenic to crucian carp.
outcome: 疾病易感性/致病性确认

quote: The results indicated that the R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 had a cumulative mortality rate of 73.3% at a dose of 2.0 × 109 CFU per fish after 14 d
statement: 结果显示，在每条鱼剂量为2.0 × 10^9 CFU的条件下，Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5在14天后的累积死亡率为73.3%。
text_zh: 结果显示，在每条鱼剂量为2.0 × 10^9 CFU的条件下，Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5在14天后的累积死亡率为73.3%。
text_en: The results showed that, at a dose of 2.0 × 10^9 CFU per fish, the cumulative mortality rate after 14 days for Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5 was 73.3%.

quote: The moribund fish exhibited sluggish behaviour, skin haemorrhages mainly located on pectoral fin base, caudal fin and parts of the body, typically in internal ascites and petechiae in liver and kidney
statement: 濒死鱼表现出行为迟缓、皮肤出血（主要位于胸鳍基部、尾鳍和身体部分），典型表现为腹水和肝脏及肾脏瘀点。
text_zh: 濒死鱼表现出行为迟缓、皮肤出血（主要位于胸鳍基部、尾鳍和身体部分），典型表现为腹水和肝脏及肾脏瘀点。
text_en: Moribund fish exhibited sluggish behavior, skin hemorrhages (mainly at the base of the pectoral fins, tail fin, and parts of the body), with typical manifestations including ascites and petechiae in the liver and kidneys.

quote: Experimental fish were confirmed to be culture negative for bacterial infection by culturing liver and kidney samples from representative groups of fish on LB plates.
statement: 通过在LB平板上培养代表性鱼群的肝脏和肾脏样本，确认实验鱼细菌培养结果为阴性。
text_zh: 通过在LB平板上培养代表性鱼群的肝脏和肾脏样本，确认实验鱼细菌培养结果为阴性。
text_en: Bacterial culture results for experimental fish were confirmed to be negative by culturing liver and kidney samples from representative fish on LB plates.

quote: Moreover, experimental challenges were conducted and demonstrated the pathogenicity of the R. aquatilis isolate for crucian carp.
statement: Experimental challenge studies demonstrated that the R. aquatilis isolate is pathogenic to crucian carp.
text_en: Experimental challenge studies demonstrated that the R. aquatilis isolate is pathogenic to crucian carp.

quote: The fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO, USA) before dissection.
statement: 实验前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 实验前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before the experiment.

quote: Narcotic drugs was fed before blood sampling.
statement: 在采血前喂食了麻醉药物。
text_zh: 在采血前喂食了麻醉药物。
text_en: Anesthetic drugs were fed before blood sampling.

quote: nampta is involved in regulating feeding and energy homeostasis in goldfish (87).
statement: nampta参与调节金鱼的摄食和能量稳态。
text_zh: nampta参与调节金鱼的摄食和能量稳态。
text_en: nampta is involved in regulating feeding and energy homeostasis in goldfish.

quote: all dissections were performed under sodium pentobarbital anaesthesia
statement: 所有解剖操作均在戊巴比妥钠麻醉下进行。
text_zh: 所有解剖操作均在戊巴比妥钠麻醉下进行。
text_en: All dissection procedures were performed under sodium pentobarbital anesthesia.
outcome: 痛苦最小化/安乐死程序

quote: and all efforts were made to minimize suffering.
statement: 已尽一切努力减少动物的痛苦。
text_zh: 已尽一切努力减少动物的痛苦。
text_en: Every effort has been made to reduce animal suffering.
intervention_record: 减少动物负面影响措施

quote: The fish were kept in tanks with circulated and aerated water at 25°C (2 × 1.5 × 1.5 m) for 15 days and fed twice a day with a commercial diet before experiments.
statement: 实验前，鲫鱼在循环充氧水、25°C的养殖缸中饲养15天，并每天投喂两次商业饲料。
text_zh: 实验前，鲫鱼在循环充氧水、25°C的养殖缸中饲养15天，并每天投喂两次商业饲料。
text_en: Before the experiment, crucian carp were kept for 15 days in rearing tanks with recirculating oxygenated water at 25°C and fed commercial feed twice daily.
intervention_record: 循环水养殖与定量投喂

quote:
Prior to
experiments, 5 fish were maintained in each 30 l tank
(filled with 20 l of water) in a water recirculation sys-
tem with a hydrocyclone prefilter (Hailea).
statement: 实验前，每30升水箱（装水20升）中饲养5条鱼，使用带有旋流预过滤器的循环水系统。
text_zh: 实验前，每30升水箱（装水20升）中饲养5条鱼，使用带有旋流预过滤器的循环水系统。
text_en: Before the experiment, 5 fish were reared in each 30-liter tank (containing 20 liters of water), using a recirculating aquaculture system with a swirl pre-filter.

quote:
Fish were infected by intraperitoneal (i.p.)
injection with 0.2 ml of the bacterial suspensions.
statement: 鱼通过腹腔注射0.2毫升细菌悬浮液进行感染。
text_zh: 鱼通过腹腔注射0.2毫升细菌悬浮液进行感染。
text_en: Fish were infected by intraperitoneal injection of 0.2 mL bacterial suspension.

quote:
For LD50 determination, 15 fish per dilution were injected with a suspension of strain
KCL-5 at 106, 107, 108, 109 and 1010 CFU ml−1.
statement: 为确定LD50，每个稀释度注射15条鱼，菌株KCL-5浓度分别为10^6至10^10 CFU/ml。
text_zh: 为确定LD50，每个稀释度注射15条鱼，菌株KCL-5浓度分别为10^6至10^10 CFU/ml。
text_en: To determine the LD50, 15 fish were injected at each dilution with strain KCL-5 concentrations ranging from 10^6 to 10^10 CFU/ml.
outcome: 疾病严重程度/剂量效应

quote:
During the trial, fish were offered
feed once daily at a rate of 3% of their body weight
(Tongwei).
statement: 试验期间，每天按体重的3%投喂一次饲料。
text_zh: 试验期间，每天按体重的3%投喂一次饲料。
text_en: During the trial period, feed was provided once daily at 3% of body weight.

quote: Table 3. Cumulative mortality of crucian carp Carassius auratus (n = 15 fish per concentration, injected i.p. with 0.2 ml bacterial suspension) and lethal dose (LD50) testing of Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5
statement: 表3展示了通过腹腔注射0.2毫升细菌悬液对鲫鱼进行Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5的半数致死量（LD50）测试及累积死亡率数据。
text_zh: 表3展示了通过腹腔注射0.2毫升细菌悬液对鲫鱼进行Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5的半数致死量（LD50）测试及累积死亡率数据。
text_en: Table 3 shows the median lethal dose (LD50) test and cumulative mortality data for crucian carp infected with Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5 via intraperitoneal injection of 0.2 mL bacterial suspension.
counterevidence: 高浓度细菌注射导致显著死亡

quote: Fig. 3. Clinical signs of experimental infection with Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5 in crucian carp Carassius auratus. The moribund fish exhibited (a) haemorrhages on skin and (b) petechiae in liver and kidney
statement: 图3显示了Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5实验感染鲫鱼的临床体征，濒死鱼表现出皮肤出血以及肝脏和肾脏瘀点。
text_zh: 图3显示了Rahnella aquatilis菌株KCL-5实验感染鲫鱼的临床体征，濒死鱼表现出皮肤出血以及肝脏和肾脏瘀点。
text_en: Figure 3 shows the clinical signs of crucian carp experimentally infected with Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5; moribund fish exhibited skin hemorrhage and petechiae in the liver and kidneys.
counterevidence: 感染导致组织出血和器官损伤

quote: The virulence factor heat-labile toxin gene (lt) of R. aquatilis was detected in fish (Lindberg et al. 1998).
statement: 在鱼类中检测到了R. aquatilis的热不稳定毒素基因（lt）这一毒力因子。
text_zh: 在鱼类中检测到了R. aquatilis的热不稳定毒素基因（lt）这一毒力因子。
text_en: The heat-labile toxin gene (lt), a virulence factor of R. aquatilis, was detected in fish.

quote: In our study, the toxin yhaV gene was detected in the R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 from crucian carp.
statement: 在本研究中，从鲫鱼分离的 R. aquatilis 菌株 KCL-5 中检测到了毒素 yhaV 基因。
text_zh: 在本研究中，从鲫鱼分离的 R. aquatilis 菌株 KCL-5 中检测到了毒素 yhaV 基因。
text_en: In this study, the toxin yhaV gene was detected in R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 isolated from crucian carp.

quote: In vivo , after CyHV-2 challenge, CagC3 transcription was significantly upregulated in liver, spleen and kidney with the peaks at 24 hr, 2 d, and 2 d, respectively.
statement: 在体内，经CyHV-2攻击后，肝脏、脾脏和肾脏中的CagC3转录显著上调，峰值分别出现在24小时、2天和2天。
text_zh: 在体内，经CyHV-2攻击后，肝脏、脾脏和肾脏中的CagC3转录显著上调，峰值分别出现在24小时、2天和2天。
text_en: In vivo, after CyHV-2 challenge, CagC3 transcription was significantly upregulated in the liver, spleen, and kidney, with peaks occurring at 24 hours, 2 days, and 2 days, respectively.
outcome: 病毒感染后的免疫反应

quote: Virus-injected carp (n=5 per time point; 40 total) and PBS-injected carp (n=5 per time point; 40 total) were sacrificed at 0, 6, 12 and 24 hr, and 2, 3, 6 and 9 d after challenge.
statement: 病毒注射组和PBS注射组的鲤鱼在攻击后的0、6、12和24小时以及第2、3、6和9天被处死。
text_zh: 病毒注射组和PBS注射组的鲤鱼在攻击后的0、6、12和24小时以及第2、3、6和9天被处死。
text_en: Carp in the virus injection group and the PBS injection group were euthanized at 0, 6, 12, and 24 hours post-challenge and on days 2, 3, 6, and 9.

quote: The results for antibiotic resistance of KCL-5 do not agree with those for R. aquatilis from humans and frogs (Goubau et al. 1988, Carinder et al. 2001, Xue et al. 2013), which provides information for clinical treatment and infection prevention caused by R. aquatilis in fish.
statement: KCL-5 的抗生素耐药性结果与来自人类和青蛙的 R. aquatilis 不一致，这为鱼类中由 R. aquatilis 引起的临床治疗和感染预防提供了信息。
text_zh: KCL-5 的抗生素耐药性结果与来自人类和青蛙的 R. aquatilis 不一致，这为鱼类中由 R. aquatilis 引起的临床治疗和感染预防提供了信息。
text_en: The antibiotic resistance results of KCL-5 are inconsistent with R. aquatilis from humans and frogs, which provides information for clinical treatment and infection prevention caused by R. aquatilis in fish.

quote: Water temperature for normal development of the eggs ranges from 15•Ž to 25•Ž., the optimum for it being at about 20•Ž.
statement: 卵の正常な発育のための水温は15℃から25℃の範囲であり、その最適値は約20℃である。
text_zh: 卵の正常な発育のための水温は15℃から25℃の範囲であり、その最適値は約20℃である。
text_en: The water temperature range for normal egg development is 15°C to 25°C, with an optimal value of about 20°C.

quote: 管瓶内の用水は2日目毎に豫め温度を調節して置いた等温水を以てその約2/3量を交換した。
statement: 試験管内の水は2日ごとに、事前に温度を調整した等温水を用いて約2/3の量を入れ替えた。
text_zh: 試験管内の水は2日ごとに、事前に温度を調整した等温水を用いて約2/3の量を入れ替えた。

quote: After deep anesthesia with MS-222 (200 mg/L), the gill tissues samples were aseptically collected and fixed in 10% formalin for 24 h, respectively.
statement: 在MS-222（200 mg/L）深度麻醉后，无菌采集鳃组织样本并分别在10%福尔马林中固定24小时。
text_zh: 在MS-222（200 mg/L）深度麻醉后，无菌采集鳃组织样本并分别在10%福尔马林中固定24小时。
text_en: After deep anesthesia with MS-222 (200 mg/L), gill tissue samples were collected aseptically and fixed in 10% formalin for 24 hours, respectively.
outcome: 实验操作中的动物福利与应激控制

quote: い高濃度 θ+Mと、θ よりMだけ低い低濃度〓一31とに交互に一定時間宛保つときの孵化日数と孵化率化とを夫々 T,〟 と(N/No)31とし.始終 θ に保つたときの孵化日 と孵化率 とを夫kTuと(N/Na)oとすれば
statement: 研究では、水温を平均値θから上下M℃変動させる条件と、常にθに保つ対照条件における孵化日数と孵化率を比較した。
text_zh: 研究では、水温を平均値θから上下M℃変動させる条件と、常にθに保つ対照条件における孵化日数と孵化率を比較した。
text_en: The study compared hatching days and hatching rate between conditions where water temperature was fluctuated up and down by M°C from the mean value θ, and a control condition where it was always kept at θ.
outcome: 孵化性能（孵化日数・孵化率）

quote: (3)歐洲フナ卵を平均水温31.5℃～11.8℃の範園内に於て、雫均差1.0。～9・8℃によつて表はされる温度の變化を與へるときは、その雫均差の増加するに從つて孵化率不良となり且つ平均孵化日撤短縮する。
statement: 平均水温11.8〜31.5℃の範囲で水温の変動幅（平均差）を増加させると、孵化率が低下し、平均孵化日数が短縮する。
text_zh: 平均水温11.8〜31.5℃の範囲で水温の変動幅（平均差）を増加させると、孵化率が低下し、平均孵化日数が短縮する。
text_en: Increasing the range of water temperature fluctuation (mean difference) within a mean water temperature range of 11.8–31.5°C decreases hatching rate and shortens the mean number of days to hatch.
outcome: 孵化率および孵化日数
counterevidence: 変動幅の増加が孵化率を悪化させる。

quote: 之によれば歐洲フナ卵も川尻氏の本邦フナ並にウグヒ(2)及び=ジマス(5).諌早・羅野高橋3氏のニシン(6)、筆者のコヒの及びワカサギ(fi)卵等と同様に水温の變化を受けること大なるもの印ち水温平均差の大なるもの程孵化率悪くなり、孵牝日数も短縮されることがわかる。
statement: 水温の変動幅（水温平均差）が大きいほど孵化率が低下し、孵化日数が短縮される傾向がある。
text_zh: 水温の変動幅（水温平均差）が大きいほど孵化率が低下し、孵化日数が短縮される傾向がある。
text_en: The greater the range of water temperature fluctuation (mean water temperature difference), the more hatching rate decreases and the shorter the number of days to hatch tends to be.
outcome: 孵化率および孵化日数

quote: The moribund crucian carp (C. auratus) infected with A. hydrophila displayed the hyperemia, hemorrhage, and inflammatory lesion of mucosal tissues (gills, skin and intestine), and congestion of visceral organs.
statement: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的濒死鲫鱼表现出黏膜组织（鳃、皮肤和肠道）充血、出血和炎症病变，以及内脏器官淤血。
text_zh: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的濒死鲫鱼表现出黏膜组织（鳃、皮肤和肠道）充血、出血和炎症病变，以及内脏器官淤血。
text_en: Moribund crucian carp infected with Aeromonas hydrophila exhibited congestion, hemorrhage, and inflammatory lesions in mucosal tissues (gills, skin, and intestine), as well as visceral organ congestion.

quote: Pathologic examination revealed a large number of inflammatory cell infiltration in the base of gill lamellae, and the respiratory epithelial cells of secondary gill lamellae were hyperplasia, sloughing and necrosis in the infected fish, and no obvious pathological changes were observed in the control group fish
statement: 病理检查显示感染鱼的鳃小片基部有大量炎性细胞浸润，次级鳃小片的呼吸上皮细胞出现增生、脱落和坏死，而对照组鱼未观察到明显的病理变化。
text_zh: 病理检查显示感染鱼的鳃小片基部有大量炎性细胞浸润，次级鳃小片的呼吸上皮细胞出现增生、脱落和坏死，而对照组鱼未观察到明显的病理变化。
text_en: Pathological examination showed massive infiltration of inflammatory cells at the base of the gill lamellae in infected fish, with proliferation, detachment, and necrosis of the respiratory epithelial cells of the secondary gill lamellae, while no obvious pathological changes were observed in the control group fish.

quote: nation revealed a large number of inflammatory cell infiltration in the base of gill lamellae, and the respiratory epithelial cells of secondary gill lamellae were hyperplasia, sloughing and necrosis in the infected fish, and no obvious pathological changes were observed in the control group fish (Fig. 1).
statement: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼鳃部出现大量炎症细胞浸润、呼吸上皮细胞增生、脱落和坏死，而对照组鱼无明显病理变化。
text_zh: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼鳃部出现大量炎症细胞浸润、呼吸上皮细胞增生、脱落和坏死，而对照组鱼无明显病理变化。
text_en: Gills of crucian carp infected with A. hydrophila showed massive infiltration of inflammatory cells, proliferation, detachment and necrosis of respiratory epithelial cells, while no significant pathological changes were observed in the control fish.

quote: Overall, in the gill of C. auratus , the detected 3842 DEGs were 1829 up- and 2013 down-regulated genes compared with the control fish.
statement: 与对照鱼相比，感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼鳃组织中检测到3842个差异表达基因，其中1829个上调，2013个下调。
text_zh: 与对照鱼相比，感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼鳃组织中检测到3842个差异表达基因，其中1829个上调，2013个下调。
text_en: Compared with control fish, 3842 differentially expressed genes were detected in the gill tissue of crucian carp infected with A. hydrophila, of which 1829 were upregulated and 2013 were downregulated.

quote: Crucian carp (C. auratus , average weight 50 g) were cultured and acclimated 14 days under the laboratory conditions for artificial infection, and maintained at 25 ± 2 °C in a flowthrough water system.
statement: 鲫鱼在实验室条件下适应14天，并在流水系统中维持于25±2°C。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在实验室条件下适应14天，并在流水系统中维持于25±2°C。
text_en: Crucian carp were acclimated under laboratory conditions for 14 days and maintained at 25±2°C in a flow-through system.
intervention_record: 实验室适应与流水养殖

quote: Fishes were challenged with A. hydrophila by immersion as our previously reported by Wang et al. [ 30 ], and fed with commercial dried pelleted feed (Tongwei, China) twice daily.
statement: 鱼通过浸泡方式感染嗜水气单胞菌，并每日两次投喂商业干燥颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 鱼通过浸泡方式感染嗜水气单胞菌，并每日两次投喂商业干燥颗粒饲料。
text_en: Fish were infected with Aeromonas hydrophila by immersion and fed commercial dry pellet feed twice daily.

quote: For the challenge, the fish were immersed in 1.0 × 10 8 colony forming unit (cfu) per milliliter of A. hydrophila for three hours, and then the inoculated fish were transferred to freshwater culture for the infection.
statement: 攻毒时，鱼在每毫升1.0×10^8 CFU的嗜水气单胞菌中浸泡三小时，随后转入淡水培养以进行感染。
text_zh: 攻毒时，鱼在每毫升1.0×10^8 CFU的嗜水气单胞菌中浸泡三小时，随后转入淡水培养以进行感染。
text_en: During challenge, fish were immersed for three hours in Aeromonas hydrophila at 1.0×10^8 CFU per milliliter, then transferred to freshwater culture for infection.

quote: pathogenic A. hydrophila could cause Aeromonas septicemia and hemorrhagic septicemia, resulting in significant economic losses
statement: 致病性嗜水气单胞菌可引起气单胞菌败血症和出血性败血症，导致显著的经济损失。
text_zh: 致病性嗜水气单胞菌可引起气单胞菌败血症和出血性败血症，导致显著的经济损失。
text_en: Pathogenic Aeromonas hydrophila can cause aeromonad septicemia and hemorrhagic septicemia, leading to significant economic losses.

quote: the pathogenic A. hydrophila infected-fish displayed obviously clinical symptoms during early infection at about 12 hpi, which then was quickly developed a typical signs of this disease
statement: 感染致病性嗜水气单胞菌的鱼在早期感染约12小时后出现明显的临床症状，随后迅速发展为该疾病的典型体征。
text_zh: 感染致病性嗜水气单胞菌的鱼在早期感染约12小时后出现明显的临床症状，随后迅速发展为该疾病的典型体征。
text_en: Fish infected with pathogenic A. hydrophila develop obvious clinical symptoms about 12 hours after early infection, which then rapidly progress to the typical signs of the disease.

quote: The pathological changes were basically consistent with inflammatory cell infiltration, hemorrhage and necrosis accorded with previous A. hydrophila infection reports
statement: 病理变化主要表现为炎症细胞浸润、出血和坏死，这与之前的嗜水气单胞菌感染报告一致。
text_zh: 病理变化主要表现为炎症细胞浸润、出血和坏死，这与之前的嗜水气单胞菌感染报告一致。
text_en: The pathological changes mainly manifested as inflammatory cell infiltration, hemorrhage and necrosis, which is consistent with previous reports of A. hydrophila infection.

quote: In recent years, the outbreak cases of infectious disease were becoming more frequent in crucian carp C. auratus in China
statement: 近年来，中国鲫鱼的传染病爆发案例变得更加频繁。
text_zh: 近年来，中国鲫鱼的传染病爆发案例变得更加频繁。
text_en: In recent years, cases of infectious disease outbreaks in farmed crucian carp in China have become more frequent.

quote: In fish, the Gram-negative bacterium A. hydrophila is considered to be one of the important pathogens that causes septicaemia and high mortality in C. auratus
statement: 在鱼类中，革兰氏阴性菌嗜水气单胞菌被认为是导致鲫鱼败血症和高死亡率的重要病原体之一。
text_zh: 在鱼类中，革兰氏阴性菌嗜水气单胞菌被认为是导致鲫鱼败血症和高死亡率的重要病原体之一。
text_en: In fish, the Gram-negative bacterium Aeromonas hydrophila is considered one of the important pathogens causing septicemia and high mortality in crucian carp.

quote: As an opportunistic pathogen of fish and terrestrial animals, it is thereby bringing tremendous economic losses
statement: 作为鱼类和陆生动物的机会性病原体，它由此带来了巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 作为鱼类和陆生动物的机会性病原体，它由此带来了巨大的经济损失。
text_en: As an opportunistic pathogen of fish and terrestrial animals, it has caused huge economic losses.

quote: In the gills of teleost fish to hypoxia stress found various innate immune-relevant genes were significantly down-regulated, such as complements, coagulation factors and chemokines [ 18 ].
statement: 在硬骨鱼的鳃中，低氧胁迫导致各种先天免疫相关基因显著下调，例如补体、凝血因子和趋化因子。
text_zh: 在硬骨鱼的鳃中，低氧胁迫导致各种先天免疫相关基因显著下调，例如补体、凝血因子和趋化因子。
text_en: In the gills of teleost fish, hypoxia stress led to a significant downregulation of various innate immunity-related genes, such as complement, coagulation factors, and chemokines.

quote: Notably, in the present study, the complement signaling pathway was found to be enriched in both transcription and protein levels in the gill of C. auratus following exposure to A. hydrophila .
statement: 值得注意的是，在本研究中，暴露于嗜水气单胞菌后，在C. auratus的鳃中发现补体信号通路在转录和蛋白质水平上均富集。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在本研究中，暴露于嗜水气单胞菌后，在C. auratus的鳃中发现补体信号通路在转录和蛋白质水平上均富集。
text_en: It is worth noting that in this study, after exposure to Aeromonas hydrophila, the complement signaling pathway was enriched at both the transcriptional and protein levels in the gills of C. auratus.

quote: Fig. 2 Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and differentially expressed proteins (DEPs) between control and A. hydrophila -infected C. auratus .
statement: 图2展示了对照组与受嗜水气单胞菌感染的鲫鱼之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）和差异表达蛋白（DEPs）。
text_zh: 图2展示了对照组与受嗜水气单胞菌感染的鲫鱼之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）和差异表达蛋白（DEPs）。
text_en: Figure 2 shows the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and differentially expressed proteins (DEPs) between the control group and crucian carp infected with A. hydrophila.

quote: Fish was severed the connection between spine cord and brain, and placed on ice.
statement: 鱼被切断脊髓与大脑的连接，并放置在冰上。
text_zh: 鱼被切断脊髓与大脑的连接，并放置在冰上。
text_en: Fish had their spinal cord and brain connections severed, and were placed on ice.

quote: our report on gill mucosal immunity revealed that complement and coagulation cascades, acute-phase protein response, antigen processing and presentation signaling pathway act as an the important immune response to overcome A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 关于鳃黏膜免疫的报告揭示，补体和凝血级联、急性期蛋白反应以及抗原加工和呈递信号通路是克服嗜水气单胞菌感染的重要免疫反应。
text_zh: 关于鳃黏膜免疫的报告揭示，补体和凝血级联、急性期蛋白反应以及抗原加工和呈递信号通路是克服嗜水气单胞菌感染的重要免疫反应。
text_en: Reports on gill mucosal immunity reveal that the complement and coagulation cascades, acute phase protein response, and antigen processing and presentation signaling pathways are important immune responses for overcoming Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: In the present study of the transcriptome and proteome in the gills in A. hydrophila -infected C. auratus , our data suggest that many DEGs and DEPs were involved in the same immune defenses, including the antigen presentation, chemokine, complements, phagosome and inflammatory pathway.
statement: 在感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲤鱼的鳃转录组和蛋白质组研究中，数据表明许多差异表达基因和蛋白质参与了相同的免疫防御，包括抗原呈递、趋化因子、补体、吞噬体和炎症通路。
text_zh: 在感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲤鱼的鳃转录组和蛋白质组研究中，数据表明许多差异表达基因和蛋白质参与了相同的免疫防御，包括抗原呈递、趋化因子、补体、吞噬体和炎症通路。
text_en: In transcriptomic and proteomic studies of the gills of carp infected with A. hydrophila, data indicate that many differentially expressed genes and proteins are involved in the same immune defenses, including antigen presentation, chemokine, complement, phagosome, and inflammatory pathways.

quote: In addition, transcriptome analyses of kidney, liver and spleen tissues of Chinese sturgeon (Acipenser sinensis), Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) challenged by bacterial Citrobacter freundii and Streptococcus agalactiae has revealed that antigen presentation signalings were significantly enriched among post-infection altered genes [ 41 , 42 ].
statement: 此外，对受到弗氏柠檬酸杆菌和无乳链球菌攻击的中华鲟和尼罗罗非鱼的肾脏、肝脏和脾脏组织的转录组分析显示，感染后改变的基因中抗原呈递信号显著富集。
text_zh: 此外，对受到弗氏柠檬酸杆菌和无乳链球菌攻击的中华鲟和尼罗罗非鱼的肾脏、肝脏和脾脏组织的转录组分析显示，感染后改变的基因中抗原呈递信号显著富集。
text_en: In addition, transcriptome analysis of kidney, liver and spleen tissues from Chinese sturgeon and Nile tilapia challenged with Citrobacter freundii and Streptococcus agalactiae showed that antigen presentation signaling was significantly enriched among the genes altered after infection.

quote: Enrofloxacin (ENR) is a kind of quinolone antibiotic that is most widely used antimicrobials in veterinary practice, and possesses both a broad spectrum antimicrobial activity against a range of bacteria and adverse effects towards plants and animals.
statement: 恩诺沙星是一种广泛用于兽医实践的喹诺酮类抗生素，具有广谱抗菌活性，但对植物和动物也有副作用。
text_zh: 恩诺沙星是一种广泛用于兽医实践的喹诺酮类抗生素，具有广谱抗菌活性，但对植物和动物也有副作用。
text_en: Enrofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic widely used in veterinary practice, with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, but it also has side effects on plants and animals.

quote: This study was conducted to explore the permeability of blood–brain barrier (BBB) to ENR and brain injury based on crucian carp orally administrated with high dose of ENR.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨口服高剂量恩诺沙星的鲫鱼血脑屏障对恩诺沙星的通透性及脑损伤情况。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨口服高剂量恩诺沙星的鲫鱼血脑屏障对恩诺沙星的通透性及脑损伤情况。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the permeability of the blood-brain barrier in crucian carp to enrofloxacin and the extent of brain damage following oral administration of high-dose enrofloxacin.
outcome: 脑损伤与血脑屏障通透性

quote: Data indicated that ENR destroyed BBB structure of crucian carp and enhanced permeability of the biological barrier, resulting in more ENR crossed BBB and induced brain damage of crucian carp.
statement: 数据表明，恩诺沙星破坏了鲫鱼的血脑屏障结构并增强了生物屏障的通透性，导致更多恩诺沙星穿过血脑屏障并诱发鲫鱼脑损伤。
text_zh: 数据表明，恩诺沙星破坏了鲫鱼的血脑屏障结构并增强了生物屏障的通透性，导致更多恩诺沙星穿过血脑屏障并诱发鲫鱼脑损伤。
text_en: Data indicate that enrofloxacin disrupted the blood-brain barrier structure of crucian carp and increased the permeability of the biological barrier, leading to more enrofloxacin crossing the blood-brain barrier and inducing brain damage in crucian carp.
outcome: 血脑屏障结构与脑损伤

quote: This data indicated that ENR can induce brain damage of crucian carp through destroying BBB structure and enhancing permeability.
statement: 这些数据表明，恩诺沙星可以通过破坏血脑屏障结构和增强通透性来诱导鲫鱼脑损伤。
text_zh: 这些数据表明，恩诺沙星可以通过破坏血脑屏障结构和增强通透性来诱导鲫鱼脑损伤。
text_en: These data indicate that enrofloxacin can induce brain injury in crucian carp by disrupting the structure of the blood-brain barrier and enhancing its permeability.

quote: In the present study on the gills in A. hydrophila -infected C. auratus , the expression level of MHC II was significantly down-regulated in expression of 0.27-fold,
statement: 在本研究中，嗜水气单胞菌感染的金鱼鳃中MHC II的表达水平显著下调至0.27倍。
text_zh: 在本研究中，嗜水气单胞菌感染的金鱼鳃中MHC II的表达水平显著下调至0.27倍。
text_en: In this study, MHC II expression levels in the gills of goldfish infected with Aeromonas hydrophila were significantly downregulated to 0.27-fold.

quote: The three markers can be detected in serum if BBB is damaged (Helmrich et al., 2020).
statement: 如果血脑屏障受损，可以在血清中检测到这三种标志物。
text_zh: 如果血脑屏障受损，可以在血清中检测到这三种标志物。
text_en: If the blood-brain barrier is damaged, these three markers can be detected in serum.

quote: Detection of brain‐derived proteins in serum is considered to be an effective method to evaluate the degree of BBB damage.
statement: 检测血清中的脑源性蛋白被认为是评估血脑屏障损伤程度的有效方法。
text_zh: 检测血清中的脑源性蛋白被认为是评估血脑屏障损伤程度的有效方法。
text_en: Detecting brain-derived proteins in serum is considered an effective method for assessing the degree of blood-brain barrier damage.

quote: In aquatic organisms, especially in fish, ENR can accumulate in fish, which impacts growth and development (Chen et al., 2019).
statement: 在水生生物特别是鱼类中，恩诺沙星会在鱼体内积累，从而影响其生长发育。
text_zh: 在水生生物特别是鱼类中，恩诺沙星会在鱼体内积累，从而影响其生长发育。
text_en: In aquatic organisms, especially fish, enrofloxacin accumulates in the fish body, thereby affecting their growth and development.

quote: Our previous work investigated the toxicity of difloxacin, another member of FQLs, to Carassius auratus gibelio , and found that both difloxacin doses, 2480 and 20 mg/kg, could lead to abnormal expression of inhibitory neurotransmitter γ‐aminobutyric acid related anabolic genes, indicating that difloxacin influenced central nervous system (Ruan et
statement: 先前的研究发现，两种剂量的双氟沙星（2480和20 mg/kg）均会导致抑制性神经递质γ-氨基丁酸相关合成基因表达异常，表明双氟沙星影响了中枢神经系统。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，两种剂量的双氟沙星（2480和20 mg/kg）均会导致抑制性神经递质γ-氨基丁酸相关合成基因表达异常，表明双氟沙星影响了中枢神经系统。
text_en: Previous studies have found that both doses of difloxacin (2480 and 20 mg/kg) caused abnormal expression of genes related to the synthesis of the inhibitory neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid, indicating that difloxacin affected the central nervous system.

quote: In addition, HSPs play a highly conserved role in immune responses and defenses against bacterial infection in fishes [ 41 ].
statement: 热休克蛋白（HSPs）在鱼类的免疫反应和抗细菌感染防御中发挥高度保守的作用。
text_zh: 热休克蛋白（HSPs）在鱼类的免疫反应和抗细菌感染防御中发挥高度保守的作用。
text_en: Heat shock proteins (HSPs) play a highly conserved role in the immune response and defense against bacterial infection in fish.

quote: Based on the present observation for the protein expression level of Hsp90 was altered obviously after infection with up-regulation of 1.58-fold in the gills of C. auratus challenged A. hydrophila, and several studies in the gills of I. punctatus [ 12 ], Ya fish Schizothorax prenanti and Chinese sturgeon Acipenser sinensis [ 41 , 48 ], it demonstrating that the differentially expressed pattern of HSP90 was early induced after bacterial infection and consequently provided an important immune resistance.
statement: 本研究中感染后鲫鱼鳃部Hsp90蛋白表达水平明显改变，上调了1.58倍，结合其他鱼类的研究，表明HSP90的差异表达模式在细菌感染后被早期诱导，从而提供了重要的免疫抵抗力。
text_zh: 本研究中感染后鲫鱼鳃部Hsp90蛋白表达水平明显改变，上调了1.58倍，结合其他鱼类的研究，表明HSP90的差异表达模式在细菌感染后被早期诱导，从而提供了重要的免疫抵抗力。
text_en: In this study, the Hsp90 protein expression level in the gills of crucian carp changed significantly after infection, being upregulated by 1.58-fold. Combined with studies on other fish species, this indicates that the differential expression pattern of HSP90 is induced early after bacterial infection, thereby providing important immune resistance.

population.species: C. auratus; I. punctatus; Schizothorax prenanti; Acipenser sinensis

quote: Several studies have found that the expressions of CALR in the spleen of O. niloticus and liver of I. punctatus were rapidly increased after the infection [ 49 , 50 ].
statement: 多项研究发现，感染后尼罗罗非鱼脾脏和斑点叉尾鮰肝脏中的CALR表达迅速增加。
text_zh: 多项研究发现，感染后尼罗罗非鱼脾脏和斑点叉尾鮰肝脏中的CALR表达迅速增加。
text_en: Multiple studies found that CALR expression rapidly increased in the spleen of Nile tilapia and the liver of channel catfish after infection.

quote: The present study was designed to use blends of TMM, CM, CAP, and CPC of different ratios to replace different levels of dietary FM so as to find the optimal blend and replacement level when considering growth, protein utilization, and intestinal health.
statement: 本研究旨在利用不同比例的TMM、CM、CAP和CPC混合物替代不同水平的日粮鱼粉，以在考虑生长、蛋白质利用率和肠道健康的情况下找到最佳混合物和替代水平。
text_zh: 本研究旨在利用不同比例的TMM、CM、CAP和CPC混合物替代不同水平的日粮鱼粉，以在考虑生长、蛋白质利用率和肠道健康的情况下找到最佳混合物和替代水平。
text_en: This study aims to use mixtures of TMM, CM, CAP and CPC at different ratios to replace different levels of dietary fishmeal, in order to find the optimal mixture and replacement level considering growth, protein utilization and gut health.
outcome: 生长、蛋白质利用率、肠道健康

quote: The trial was conducted to investigate the effects of the replacement of dietary fishmeal (FM) by the blend of Tenebrio molitor meal (TMM), Chlorella meal (CM), Clostridium autoethanogenum protein (CAP), cottonseed protein concentrate (CPC) on growth, protein utilization and intestinal health of gibel carp (Carassius gibelio , CAS Ⅴ).
statement: 本研究旨在调查用黄粉虫粉、小球藻粉、自产乙醇梭菌蛋白和棉籽蛋白浓缩物混合替代日粮鱼粉对鲫鱼生长、蛋白质利用率和肠道健康的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在调查用黄粉虫粉、小球藻粉、自产乙醇梭菌蛋白和棉籽蛋白浓缩物混合替代日粮鱼粉对鲫鱼生长、蛋白质利用率和肠道健康的影响。
text_en: This study aimed to investigate the effects of replacing dietary fish meal with a mixture of yellow mealworm powder, Chlorella powder, self-produced ethanol Clostridium protein, and cottonseed protein concentrate on growth, protein utilization, and gut health in crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、蛋白质利用率、肠道健康

quote: Many researches have been focusing on a single protein source (e.g., soybean protein) to replace FM, which came with the drawbacks of antinutrient factors and unbalanced amino acid composition that limit the replacement level of FM
statement: 许多研究集中于使用单一蛋白源（如大豆蛋白）替代鱼粉，但这带来了抗营养因子和氨基酸组成不平衡的缺点，从而限制了鱼粉的替代水平。
text_zh: 许多研究集中于使用单一蛋白源（如大豆蛋白）替代鱼粉，但这带来了抗营养因子和氨基酸组成不平衡的缺点，从而限制了鱼粉的替代水平。
text_en: Many studies have focused on using a single protein source (such as soybean protein) to replace fish meal, but this has the disadvantages of antinutritional factors and imbalanced amino acid composition, thereby limiting the level of fish meal replacement.
outcome: 饲料安全性与营养平衡
counterevidence: 存在抗营养因子和氨基酸组成不平衡的问题

quote: the permeability of brain microvessels was increased after ENR treatment, and EB was diffused in the brain microvessels of crucian carp, indicating that EB diffused into the glial cells.
statement: 恩诺沙星处理后脑微血管通透性增加，伊文思蓝扩散至鲫鱼脑微血管中，表明伊文思蓝扩散到了胶质细胞。
text_zh: 恩诺沙星处理后脑微血管通透性增加，伊文思蓝扩散至鲫鱼脑微血管中，表明伊文思蓝扩散到了胶质细胞。
text_en: After enrofloxacin treatment, blood-brain barrier permeability increased, and Evans blue diffused into the brain microvessels of crucian carp, indicating that Evans blue had diffused into glial cells.

quote: contents of crucian carp BBB related proteins, occludin and P‐gp, were significantly downregulated by single oral administration of ENR at LD 50 and SD
statement: 单次口服LD50和SD剂量的恩诺沙星显著下调了鲫鱼血脑屏障相关蛋白occludin和P-gp的含量。
text_zh: 单次口服LD50和SD剂量的恩诺沙星显著下调了鲫鱼血脑屏障相关蛋白occludin和P-gp的含量。
text_en: A single oral LD50 and SD dose of enrofloxacin significantly downregulated the content of blood-brain barrier-related proteins occludin and P-gp in crucian carp.
outcome: 血脑屏障结构蛋白表达

quote: ENR represses expressions of occludin and P‐gp, but promotes expression of GFAP, NSE and S100B in crucian carp brain
statement: 恩诺沙星抑制occludin和P-gp的表达，但促进鲫鱼脑中GFAP、NSE和S100B的表达。
text_zh: 恩诺沙星抑制occludin和P-gp的表达，但促进鲫鱼脑中GFAP、NSE和S100B的表达。
text_en: Enrofloxacin inhibits the expression of occludin and P-gp, but promotes the expression of GFAP, NSE, and S100B in the brain of crucian carp.
outcome: 神经损伤标志物及屏障蛋白表达

quote: Wu et al. [ 16 ] found that a single protein of CAP could replace dietary FM up to 30% without adverse effects on growth performance in carnivorous large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea).
statement: 研究发现，在大黄鱼日粮中，单一蛋白CAP可替代高达30%的鱼粉而不影响生长性能。
text_zh: 研究发现，在大黄鱼日粮中，单一蛋白CAP可替代高达30%的鱼粉而不影响生长性能。
text_en: The study found that in the diet of large yellow croaker, single-protein CAP can replace up to 30% of fish meal without affecting growth performance.

quote: However, 45% replacement reduced the activity of intestinal protease, damaged intestinal health, and inhibited growth.
statement: 然而，45%的鱼粉替代率降低了肠道蛋白酶活性，损害了肠道健康并抑制了生长。
text_zh: 然而，45%的鱼粉替代率降低了肠道蛋白酶活性，损害了肠道健康并抑制了生长。
text_en: However, a 45% fishmeal replacement rate reduced intestinal protease activity, impaired gut health and inhibited growth.

quote: This work revealed that ENR not only reduced the expression of TJs‐related gene occluding but also significantly inhibited P‐glycoprotein, resulting in more ENR existed in brain tissue of Pengze crucian carp and consequent brain injury.
statement: 这项工作揭示，恩诺沙星不仅降低了紧密连接相关基因occludin的表达，还显著抑制了P-糖蛋白，导致更多恩诺沙星存在于彭泽鲫脑组织中并引起随后的脑损伤。
text_zh: 这项工作揭示，恩诺沙星不仅降低了紧密连接相关基因occludin的表达，还显著抑制了P-糖蛋白，导致更多恩诺沙星存在于彭泽鲫脑组织中并引起随后的脑损伤。
text_en: This work revealed that enrofloxacin not only reduced the expression of the tight junction-related gene occludin, but also significantly inhibited P-glycoprotein, resulting in more enrofloxacin being present in the brain tissue of Pengze crucian carp and causing subsequent brain injury.

quote: S100B, NSE and GFAP have been recognised as marker molecules for astrocytes and neurons in brain, so their expression levels reflected the degree of brain injury.
statement: S100B、NSE和GFAP被公认为脑中星形胶质细胞和神经元的标志分子，因此它们的表达水平反映了脑损伤的程度。
text_zh: S100B、NSE和GFAP被公认为脑中星形胶质细胞和神经元的标志分子，因此它们的表达水平反映了脑损伤的程度。
text_en: S100B, NSE and GFAP are recognized as marker molecules for astrocytes and neurons in the brain, therefore their expression levels reflect the degree of brain damage.

quote: Our findings showed that ENR improved expression of S100B, NSE and GFAP in crucian carp brain, and higher contents of them were observed in serum.
statement: 研究发现恩诺沙星提高了鲫鱼脑中S100B、NSE和GFAP的表达，并在血清中观察到这些物质含量升高。
text_zh: 研究发现恩诺沙星提高了鲫鱼脑中S100B、NSE和GFAP的表达，并在血清中观察到这些物质含量升高。
text_en: The study found that enrofloxacin increased the expression of S100B, NSE and GFAP in the brain of crucian carp, and elevated levels of these substances were observed in serum.
outcome: 脑损伤生物标志物表达

quote: Elevated ENR‐residue‐induced brain injury was related to activation of ACs and neuron injury.
statement: 升高的恩诺沙星残留诱导的脑损伤与星形胶质细胞激活和神经元损伤有关。
text_zh: 升高的恩诺沙星残留诱导的脑损伤与星形胶质细胞激活和神经元损伤有关。
text_en: Brain injury induced by elevated enrofloxacin residue is associated with astrocyte activation and neuronal damage.

quote: In this study, it was found that expression of occludin in TJs of crucian carp BBB was extremely significantly downregulated by ENR.
statement: 本研究发现，恩诺沙星极显著下调了鲫鱼血脑屏障紧密连接中occludin的表达。
text_zh: 本研究发现，恩诺沙星极显著下调了鲫鱼血脑屏障紧密连接中occludin的表达。
text_en: This study found that enrofloxacin (ENR) significantly downregulated the expression of occludin in the tight junctions of the blood-brain barrier in crucian carp.

quote: The intestine tissues stored at paraformaldehyde solution were analyzed by hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained sections, and these stored with glutaraldehyde solution were observed under a transmission electron microscope.
statement: 肠组织经多聚甲醛固定后进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色切片分析，经戊二醛固定的组织在透射电镜下观察。
text_zh: 肠组织经多聚甲醛固定后进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色切片分析，经戊二醛固定的组织在透射电镜下观察。
text_en: Intestinal tissues fixed with paraformaldehyde were analyzed by hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining sections, and tissues fixed with glutaraldehyde were observed under transmission electron microscopy.

quote: markedly high S100B protein content was observed after treatment with ENR
statement: 经ENR处理后观察到显著高的S100B蛋白含量。
text_zh: 经ENR处理后观察到显著高的S100B蛋白含量。
text_en: Significantly high S100B protein content was observed after ENR treatment.

quote: Data in Figure 3c also showed that ENR increased NSE and GFAP protein contents in serum.
statement: 图3c中的数据还显示ENR增加了血清中的NSE和GFAP蛋白含量。
text_zh: 图3c中的数据还显示ENR增加了血清中的NSE和GFAP蛋白含量。
text_en: The data in Figure 3c also show that ENR increased the serum NSE and GFAP protein content.

quote: LD 50 ENF caused extremely significant increase of GFAP protein content in serum of crucian carp
statement: LD50剂量的ENF导致鲫鱼血清中GFAP蛋白含量极显著增加。
text_zh: LD50剂量的ENF导致鲫鱼血清中GFAP蛋白含量极显著增加。
text_en: An LD50 dose of ENF caused a highly significant increase in GFAP protein content in the serum of crucian carp.

quote: Figure 1 showed that there was no significant relationship between SGR, FE, and PRE and the dietary essential amino acid index (EAAI).
statement: 图1显示，特定生长率（SGR）、摄食效率（FE）和蛋白质效率比（PRE）与日粮必需氨基酸指数（EAAI）之间没有显著关系。
text_zh: 图1显示，特定生长率（SGR）、摄食效率（FE）和蛋白质效率比（PRE）与日粮必需氨基酸指数（EAAI）之间没有显著关系。
text_en: Figure 1 shows that there is no significant relationship between specific growth rate (SGR), feed efficiency (FE) and protein efficiency ratio (PRE) and the dietary essential amino acid index (EAAI).

quote: With the increase of dietary digestible essential amino acid index (DEAAI), SGR and FE increased significantly (reaching the maximum value when DEAAI was 79.5%; P
statement: 随着日粮可消化必需氨基酸指数（DEAAI）的增加，特定生长率（SGR）和摄食效率（FE）显著增加（当DEAAI为79.5%时达到最大值）。
text_zh: 随着日粮可消化必需氨基酸指数（DEAAI）的增加，特定生长率（SGR）和摄食效率（FE）显著增加（当DEAAI为79.5%时达到最大值）。
text_en: As the dietary digestible essential amino acid index (DEAAI) increased, specific growth rate (SGR) and feed efficiency (FE) significantly increased (reaching maximum values at a DEAAI of 79.5%).
intervention_record: 日粮可消化必需氨基酸指数

quote: In omnivorous white shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei), the dietary 30% FM replacement by CAP had no adverse effects on growth performance or intestine health, while the dietary 45% FM replacement showed negative effects on fish
statement: 在杂食性南美白对虾中，30%的菜籽粕替代鱼粉对生长性能和肠道健康无不利影响，而45%的替代水平显示出负面影响。
text_zh: 在杂食性南美白对虾中，30%的菜籽粕替代鱼粉对生长性能和肠道健康无不利影响，而45%的替代水平显示出负面影响。
text_en: In omnivorous whiteleg shrimp, replacing fishmeal with 30% rapeseed meal had no adverse effects on growth performance and gut health, while a replacement level of 45% showed negative effects.

quote: CPC was reported to be acceptable to replace 50% of dietary FM in carnivorous largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides), while negative effects were observed on intestinal tissue structure, protein utilization, and growth performance at 75% replacement
statement: 据报道，棉籽蛋白浓缩物可接受地替代肉食性大口黑鲷日粮中50%的鱼粉，但在75%替代水平下观察到对肠道组织结构、蛋白质利用率和生长性能的负面影响。
text_zh: 据报道，棉籽蛋白浓缩物可接受地替代肉食性大口黑鲷日粮中50%的鱼粉，但在75%替代水平下观察到对肠道组织结构、蛋白质利用率和生长性能的负面影响。
text_en: It is reported that cottonseed protein concentrate can acceptably replace 50% of fishmeal in the diet of carnivorous largemouth bass, but negative effects on intestinal tissue structure, protein utilization, and growth performance were observed at a 75% replacement level.
intervention_record: 棉籽蛋白浓缩物替代鱼粉
outcome: 肠道结构、蛋白质利用率与生长性能

quote: Chlorella growth factor and chitin have positive effects on feeding, growth, and immunity of fish, while high chitin has antinutritional effects
statement: 小球藻生长因子和几丁质对鱼类的摄食、生长和免疫有积极作用，但高水平的几丁质具有抗营养作用。
text_zh: 小球藻生长因子和几丁质对鱼类的摄食、生长和免疫有积极作用，但高水平的几丁质具有抗营养作用。
text_en: Chlorella growth factor and chitin have positive effects on the feeding, growth, and immunity of fish, but high levels of chitin have anti-nutritional effects.
limitations: 高浓度几丁质存在抗营养效应
counterevidence: 高几丁质含量导致抗营养效果

quote: The limited replacement level might be due to unbalanced amino acid composition that could not achieve the aquaculture animal requirements.
statement: 有限的替代水平可能是由于氨基酸组成不平衡，无法满足养殖动物的需求。
text_zh: 有限的替代水平可能是由于氨基酸组成不平衡，无法满足养殖动物的需求。
text_en: Limited replacement levels may be due to an unbalanced amino acid composition that cannot meet the needs of farmed animals.
counterevidence: 限制了替代水平的提高

quote: The water temperature (0.5 m under the water surface) was 27.9–30.1°C.
text_en: Water temperature (0.5 m below the surface) was 27.9–30.1°C.

quote: Light period was from 8 : 00 to 20 : 00.
text_en: The light cycle was from 8:00 to 20:00.

quote: The water ammonia nitrogen was below 0.2 mg L −1 , the pH was 7.0–7.2, and the dissolved oxygen was higher than 7 mg L −1 .
statement: 水中氨氮低于0.2 mg/L，pH值为7.0–7.2，溶解氧高于7 mg/L。
text_zh: 水中氨氮低于0.2 mg/L，pH值为7.0–7.2，溶解氧高于7 mg/L。
text_en: Ammonia nitrogen in water is below 0.2 mg/L, pH value is 7.0–7.2, and dissolved oxygen is above 7 mg/L.

quote: The fish were fed three meal per day (7 : 00, 12 : 00, and 17 : 00) and the uneaten feed were collected after each feeding.
statement: 鱼每天喂食三餐（7:00、12:00和17:00），并在每次喂食后收集未吃的饲料。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食三餐（7:00、12:00和17:00），并在每次喂食后收集未吃的饲料。
text_en: Fish are fed three times daily (7:00, 12:00, and 17:00), and uneaten feed is collected after each feeding.

quote: found that both difloxacin doses, 2480 and 20 mg/kg, could lead to abnormal expression of inhibitory neurotransmitter γ‐aminobutyric acid related anabolic genes, indicating that difloxacin influenced central nervous system (Ruan et al., 2014).
statement: 研究发现，两种剂量的双氟沙星（2480和20 mg/kg）均可导致抑制性神经递质γ-氨基丁酸相关合成基因的异常表达，表明双氟沙星影响了中枢神经系统。
text_zh: 研究发现，两种剂量的双氟沙星（2480和20 mg/kg）均可导致抑制性神经递质γ-氨基丁酸相关合成基因的异常表达，表明双氟沙星影响了中枢神经系统。
text_en: The study found that two doses of difloxacin (2480 and 20 mg/kg) both led to abnormal expression of gamma-aminobutyric acid-related synthesis genes, an inhibitory neurotransmitter, indicating that difloxacin affected the central nervous system.
counterevidence: 药物导致基因异常表达并影响中枢神经系统

quote: So it can be assumed that ENR maybe mediate impact on brain or CNS.
statement: 因此可以假设恩诺沙星可能对大脑或中枢神经系统产生间接影响。
text_zh: 因此可以假设恩诺沙星可能对大脑或中枢神经系统产生间接影响。
text_en: Therefore, it can be assumed that enrofloxacin may have an indirect effect on the brain or central nervous system.
outcome: 脑或中枢神经系统健康

quote: The 720 fish (83.60 ± 3.72 g), healthy and free from parasites, were purchased from a farm in Pengze county, Jiangxi Province, and temporarily raised for two weeks with plenty of oxygen, which was pumped into the water.
statement: 从江西彭泽县农场购买了720条健康无寄生虫的鱼，并在充氧条件下暂养两周。
text_zh: 从江西彭泽县农场购买了720条健康无寄生虫的鱼，并在充氧条件下暂养两周。
text_en: 720 healthy, parasite-free fish were purchased from a farm in Pengze County, Jiangxi, and held for two weeks under oxygenated conditions.

quote: During the experiment, the aquaculture water was aerated by artificial aerator, and the dissolved oxygen was stabilised at 6.50 ± 0.50 mg/L, and the water temperature and pH were controlled at 25 ± 1°C and 7.50 ± 0.30.
statement: 实验期间，养殖水通过人工增氧机曝气，溶解氧稳定在6.50 ± 0.50 mg/L，水温和pH值分别控制在25 ± 1°C和7.50 ± 0.30。
text_zh: 实验期间，养殖水通过人工增氧机曝气，溶解氧稳定在6.50 ± 0.50 mg/L，水温和pH值分别控制在25 ± 1°C和7.50 ± 0.30。
text_en: During the experiment, the aquaculture water was aerated by an artificial oxygenation machine, with dissolved oxygen stabilized at 6.50 ± 0.50 mg/L, and water temperature and pH controlled at 25 ± 1°C and 7.50 ± 0.30, respectively.

quote: Feeding was stopped 24 h before the experiment.
statement: 实验前24小时停止喂食。
text_zh: 实验前24小时停止喂食。
text_en: Feeding was stopped 24 hours before the experiment.

quote: Dietary 100% replacement of FM by the blended TMM, CM, CAP, and CPC at a ratio of 1 : 1:6 : 4 could improve intestine health and protein digestibility, and growth of gibel carp.
statement: 日粮中用TMM、CM、CAP和CPC按1:1:6:4比例100%替代鱼粉可改善银鲫的肠道健康、蛋白质消化率和生长。
text_zh: 日粮中用TMM、CM、CAP和CPC按1:1:6:4比例100%替代鱼粉可改善银鲫的肠道健康、蛋白质消化率和生长。
text_en: Replacing fishmeal with TMM, CM, CAP and CPC in a ratio of 1:1:6:4 at 100% inclusion in the diet can improve gut health, protein digestibility and growth of gibel carp.

quote: The mRNA expression of anti-inflammatory il-10 in the B100 group and tgf-β in the B67 and C100 groups was significantly upregulated compared to the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，B100组中抗炎因子il-10的mRNA表达以及B67和C100组中tgf-β的mRNA表达显著上调。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，B100组中抗炎因子il-10的mRNA表达以及B67和C100组中tgf-β的mRNA表达显著上调。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the mRNA expression of the anti-inflammatory factor IL-10 in the B100 group and the mRNA expression of TGF-β in the B67 and C100 groups were significantly upregulated.

quote: Figure 6 showed that the substitution of dietary FM by blended proteins upregulated the mRNA expression of multiple intestinal tight junction-related genes
statement: 图6显示，使用混合蛋白替代日粮中的鱼粉上调了多种肠道紧密连接相关基因的mRNA表达。
text_zh: 图6显示，使用混合蛋白替代日粮中的鱼粉上调了多种肠道紧密连接相关基因的mRNA表达。
text_en: Figure 6 shows that using mixed protein to replace fishmeal in the diet upregulated the mRNA expression of multiple intestinal tight junction-related genes.

quote: In addition, the hollowing and severe curvature of the intestinal tight junction was observed in the control group through the intestinal electron microscope images, while no similar phenomenon appeared in the A100, B100, and C100 groups (Figure 6(b)).
statement: 此外，通过肠电镜图像观察到对照组的肠道紧密连接出现空泡化和严重弯曲，而A100、B100和C100组未出现类似现象。
text_zh: 此外，通过肠电镜图像观察到对照组的肠道紧密连接出现空泡化和严重弯曲，而A100、B100和C100组未出现类似现象。
text_en: In addition, intestinal electron microscopy images showed that the tight junctions of the control group exhibited vacuolization and severe bending, while similar phenomena were not observed in the A100, B100, and C100 groups.

quote: Table 4 showed that there were no significant differences in survival and feeding rate between different treatments (P > 0.05).
statement: 不同处理组之间的存活率和摄食率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 不同处理组之间的存活率和摄食率没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in survival rate and feeding rate between different treatment groups.

quote: Lower final body weight (FBW), specific growth rate (SGR), feed efficiency (FE), protein efficiency ratio (PER), and protein retention efficiency (PRE) were observed in the fish fed A100 diet
statement: 饲喂A100日粮的鱼表现出较低的终末体重、特定生长率、饲料效率、蛋白质效率和蛋白质保留效率。
text_zh: 饲喂A100日粮的鱼表现出较低的终末体重、特定生长率、饲料效率、蛋白质效率和蛋白质保留效率。
text_en: Fish fed the A100 diet showed lower final body weight, specific growth rate, feed efficiency, protein efficiency, and protein retention efficiency.

quote: Higher hepatosomatic index (HSI) was observed in the fish fed A33 diet than those in the fish fed control, A67, A100, and C67 diets
statement: 饲喂A33日粮的鱼的肝体指数高于饲喂对照、A67、A100和C67日粮的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂A33日粮的鱼的肝体指数高于饲喂对照、A67、A100和C67日粮的鱼。
text_en: The hepatosomatic index of fish fed the A33 diet was higher than that of fish fed the control, A67, A100, and C67 diets.

quote: ADCs of dry matter (ADC DM), gross energy (ADC GE), crude protein (ADC CP), total essential amino acids (ADC TEAA), and total nonessential amino acids (ADC TNEAA) in the A67 and A100 groups were significantly lower than those in the control group
statement: A67和A100组的干物质、总能、粗蛋白、总必需氨基酸和总非必需氨基酸的表观消化系数显著低于对照组。
text_zh: A67和A100组的干物质、总能、粗蛋白、总必需氨基酸和总非必需氨基酸的表观消化系数显著低于对照组。
text_en: The apparent digestibility coefficients of dry matter, gross energy, crude protein, total essential amino acids, and total non-essential amino acids in the A67 and A100 groups were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: All fish were fed with commercial diets (103, Tongwei Co., Ltd.) 3 meals/day for 2 weeks for acclimation.
statement: 所有鱼在为期两周的驯化期间，每天喂食三次商业饲料。
text_zh: 所有鱼在为期两周的驯化期间，每天喂食三次商业饲料。
text_en: All fish were fed commercial feed three times daily during a two-week acclimation period.

quote: randomly distributed into 30 cages at a density of 70 fish per cage.
statement: 鱼被随机分配到30个网箱中，密度为每箱70条鱼。
text_zh: 鱼被随机分配到30个网箱中，密度为每箱70条鱼。
text_en: Fish were randomly assigned to 30 cages at a density of 70 fish per cage.

quote: gibel carp were fed up to apparent satiation at 7 : 00, 12 : 00, and 17 : 00 for 8 weeks
statement: 在为期8周的试验期间，鲫鱼在7:00、12:00和17:00被喂至表观饱食状态。
text_zh: 在为期8周的试验期间，鲫鱼在7:00、12:00和17:00被喂至表观饱食状态。
text_en: During the 8-week trial period, crucian carp were fed to apparent satiation at 7:00, 12:00 and 17:00.

quote: The water around cages was aerated at night for 10 hr from 8 : 00 p.m. to 6 : 00 a.m.
statement: 网箱周围的水体在夜间从晚上8点到早上6点曝气10小时。
text_zh: 网箱周围的水体在夜间从晚上8点到早上6点曝气10小时。
text_en: The water around the cages was aerated for 10 hours at night, from 8 pm to 6 am.

quote: The natural light and temperature were used.
statement: 使用自然光照和温度。
text_zh: 使用自然光照和温度。
text_en: Use natural light and temperature.

quote: The water ammonia nitrogen was below 0.4 mg L −1 , pH was 7.4–7.6, and dissolved oxygen was higher than 5 mg L −1 .
statement: 水中氨氮低于0.4 mg/L，pH值为7.4-7.6，溶解氧高于5 mg/L。
text_zh: 水中氨氮低于0.4 mg/L，pH值为7.4-7.6，溶解氧高于5 mg/L。
text_en: Ammonia nitrogen in water is below 0.4 mg/L, pH value is 7.4-7.6, and dissolved oxygen is above 5 mg/L.

quote: fish were fasted for 12 hr.
statement: 鱼禁食12小时。
text_zh: 鱼禁食12小时。
text_en: Fish were fasted for 12 hours.

quote: All fish in each cage were anesthetized with MS-222 (50 mg kg −1 ; Sigma, USA) and bulk-weighed.
statement: 每个网箱中的所有鱼均用MS-222（50 mg/kg）麻醉并称重。
text_zh: 每个网箱中的所有鱼均用MS-222（50 mg/kg）麻醉并称重。
text_en: All fish in each cage were anesthetized with MS-222 (50 mg/kg) and weighed.

quote: The fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO, USA) before dissection.
statement: 鱼类在解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼类在解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before dissection.

quote: The result showed ANOVA test with p <5% indicates that the soaking juice of papaya leaves Argulus infestations affect the comet fish.
statement: Hasil uji ANOVA dengan p <5% menunjukkan bahwa perendaman jus daun pepaya terhadap infestasi Argulus mempengaruhi ikan komet.
text_en: Hasil uji ANOVA dengan p <5% menunjukkan bahwa perendaman jus daun pepaya terhadap infestasi Argulus mempengaruhi ikan komet.

quote: Figure 4(a) showed that the activities of intestinal TRY in gibel carp of the A67, B67, and B100 groups increased significantly, as well as the activities of intestinal CT of the A67 and B67 groups compared to the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，A67、B67和B100组鲫鱼肠道胰蛋白酶活性显著增加，且A67和B67组肠道糜蛋白酶活性也显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，A67、B67和B100组鲫鱼肠道胰蛋白酶活性显著增加，且A67和B67组肠道糜蛋白酶活性也显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, intestinal trypsin activity in crucian carp was significantly increased in the A67, B67, and B100 groups, and intestinal chymotrypsin activity was also significantly increased in the A67 and B67 groups.
intervention: Mixed protein feed A67, B67, B100

quote: Figure 5(d) showed that the different dietary did not significantly affect the muscle thickness of fish intestine (P > 0.05).
statement: 不同日粮对鱼肠肌肉厚度没有显著影响。
text_zh: 不同日粮对鱼肠肌肉厚度没有显著影响。
text_en: Different diets had no significant effect on fish intestinal muscle thickness.

quote: The villus height (Vh) and the ratio of villus height to crypt depth (V/C) of the A100 group were significantly lower than those of the control group
statement: A100组的绒毛高度(Vh)和绒毛高度与隐窝深度之比(V/C)显著低于对照组。
text_zh: A100组的绒毛高度(Vh)和绒毛高度与隐窝深度之比(V/C)显著低于对照组。
text_en: The villus height (Vh) and the ratio of villus height to crypt depth (V/C) in the A100 group were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: Figure 5 showed that multiple proinflammatory genes mRNA expression in the other groups was significantly upregulated compared to the control group (P tnf-α and il-6α in the A100, B100, and C groups, il-1β in the C groups, and il-8 in the A, B100, and C groups.
statement: 与其他组相比，多个促炎基因的mRNA表达显著上调，具体表现为A100、B100和C组的tnf-α和il-6α，C组的il-1β，以及A、B100和C组的il-8。
text_zh: 与其他组相比，多个促炎基因的mRNA表达显著上调，具体表现为A100、B100和C组的tnf-α和il-6α，C组的il-1β，以及A、B100和C组的il-8。
text_en: Compared with other groups, the mRNA expression of multiple pro-inflammatory genes was significantly upregulated, specifically tnf-α and il-6α in groups A100, B100, and C; il-1β in group C; and il-8 in groups A, B100, and C.

quote: il-10 in the A100 group was significantly downregula
statement: A100组的il-10显著下调。
text_zh: A100组的il-10显著下调。
text_en: il-10 was significantly downregulated in the A100 group.

quote: The present trial showed that the mRNA expression of snat2 , y + lat2 , and pept1 was upregulated when dietary replacement FM by BLEND B to a certain level respectively, which was beneficial to the absorption of protein by fish.
statement: 试验表明，当用BLEND B在一定水平上替代日粮中的鱼粉时，snat2、y+lat2和pept1的mRNA表达分别上调，这有利于鱼类对蛋白质的吸收。
text_zh: 试验表明，当用BLEND B在一定水平上替代日粮中的鱼粉时，snat2、y+lat2和pept1的mRNA表达分别上调，这有利于鱼类对蛋白质的吸收。
text_en: Experiments showed that when BLEND B replaced fish meal in the diet at a certain level, the mRNA expression of snat2, y+lat2 and pept1 was upregulated respectively, which is beneficial for protein absorption in fish.

quote: It was found that when dietary 100% replacement FM by BLEND B, the crypt depth became shallower, the villus height to crypt depth ratio (V/C) became larger, and the ML became longer in fish intestines.
statement: 研究发现，当日粮中用BLEND B 100%替代鱼粉时，鱼类肠道的隐窝深度变浅，绒毛高度与隐窝深度之比（V/C）变大，微绒毛长度（ML）变长。
text_zh: 研究发现，当日粮中用BLEND B 100%替代鱼粉时，鱼类肠道的隐窝深度变浅，绒毛高度与隐窝深度之比（V/C）变大，微绒毛长度（ML）变长。
text_en: The study found that when BLEND B replaced 100% of fish meal in the diet, the crypt depth in the fish intestine became shallower, the villus height to crypt depth ratio (V/C) increased, and the microvillus length (ML) increased.

quote: It was also found that dietary 100% replacement FM by BLEND A reduced the Vh and V/C.
statement: 还发现，日粮中用BLEND A 100%替代鱼粉降低了绒毛高度（Vh）和V/C比值。
text_zh: 还发现，日粮中用BLEND A 100%替代鱼粉降低了绒毛高度（Vh）和V/C比值。
text_en: It was also found that replacing fishmeal with BLEND A at 100% in the diet reduced villus height (Vh) and the V/C ratio.

quote: Similarly, dietary excessive single protein CAP was reported to reduce the Vh of fish intestines [ 16 , 48 ].
statement: 同样，据报道，日粮中过量的单一蛋白CAP会降低鱼类肠道的绒毛高度。
text_zh: 同样，据报道，日粮中过量的单一蛋白CAP会降低鱼类肠道的绒毛高度。
text_en: Similarly, it is reported that excessive single-protein CAP in the diet reduces intestinal villus height in fish.

quote: Better growth performance was reported in many aquaculture species to be achieved by dietary balanced amino acids of mixed proteins compared to single alternative protein [ 33 – 35 ].
statement: 据报道，与单一替代蛋白相比，许多水产养殖物种通过混合蛋白的平衡氨基酸日粮实现了更好的生长性能。
text_zh: 据报道，与单一替代蛋白相比，许多水产养殖物种通过混合蛋白的平衡氨基酸日粮实现了更好的生长性能。
text_en: It is reported that, compared with single alternative proteins, many aquaculture species achieved better growth performance through mixed-protein diets with balanced amino acids.

quote: On the other hand, the present study also showed that BLEND A was found to obtain poor growth performance at the substitution of 100% dietary FM.
statement: 另一方面，本研究也显示，在100%替代日粮鱼粉时，BLEND A的生长性能较差。
text_zh: 另一方面，本研究也显示，在100%替代日粮鱼粉时，BLEND A的生长性能较差。
text_en: On the other hand, this study also showed that when fishmeal in the diet was replaced at 100%, the growth performance of BLEND A was poorer.

quote: These suggested that the unsuitable mixed proteins could not meet the growth requirements of fish.
statement: 这些结果表明，不合适的混合蛋白无法满足鱼类的生长需求。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，不合适的混合蛋白无法满足鱼类的生长需求。
text_en: These results indicate that inappropriate mixed protein cannot meet the growth requirements of fish.

quote: Perasan daun pepaya berpengaruh terhadap presentase jumlah Argulus yang lepas dari tubuh ikan komet.
statement: Perasan daun pepaya mempengaruhi persentase jumlah Argulus yang lepas dari tubuh ikan komet.
text_en: Perasan daun pepaya mempengaruhi persentase jumlah Argulus yang lepas dari tubuh ikan komet.

quote: Konsentrasi terbaik yaitu pada perlakuan D (30%) dengan persentase rata-rata Argulus yang lepas adalah 88%.
statement: Konsentrasi perasan daun pepaya 30% menghasilkan persentase rata-rata Argulus yang lepas sebesar 88%, yang merupakan konsentrasi terbaik dalam penelitian ini.
text_en: Konsentrasi perasan daun pepaya 30% menghasilkan persentase rata-rata Argulus yang lepas sebesar 88%, yang merupakan konsentrasi terbaik dalam penelitian ini.

quote: Pengamatan tingkah laku ikan dilakukan untuk mengetahui kondisi kesehatan ikan.
statement: Pengamatan tingkah laku ikan dilakukan sebagai indikator untuk mengetahui kondisi kesehatan ikan.
text_en: Pengamatan tingkah laku ikan dilakukan sebagai indikator untuk mengetahui kondisi kesehatan ikan.

quote: Pengendalian infestasi Argulus saat ini masih mengandalkan bahan kimia misalnya dimilin, formalin dan depterex yang dapat mencemari lingkungan.
statement: Pengendalian infestasi Argulus saat ini menggunakan bahan kimia seperti dimilin, formalin, dan depterex yang berisiko mencemari lingkungan.
text_en: Pengendalian infestasi Argulus saat ini menggunakan bahan kimia seperti dimilin, formalin, dan depterex yang berisiko mencemari lingkungan.

quote: Salah satu tanaman yang dapat digunakan untuk mengendalikan parasit Argulus adalah daun pepaya.
statement: Daun pepaya merupakan salah satu tanaman yang dapat digunakan untuk mengendalikan parasit Argulus.
text_en: Daun pepaya merupakan salah satu tanaman yang dapat digunakan untuk mengendalikan parasit Argulus.

quote: Alkaloid carpain merupakan insektisida yang mempengaruhi sistem saraf (Sudarmo, 1991). Akibatnya, impuls saraf akan mengalami stimulasi dan menunjukkan gejala tak terkendali (Burdick, 1971) dan mengakibatkan Argulus tidak dapat menempel pada inang (Walker, 2005).
statement: Alkaloid carpain dalam daun pepaya bekerja sebagai insektisida yang mempengaruhi sistem saraf Argulus sehingga menyebabkan gejala tak terkendali dan mencegah parasit menempel pada inang.
text_en: Alkaloid carpain dalam daun pepaya bekerja sebagai insektisida yang mempengaruhi sistem saraf Argulus sehingga menyebabkan gejala tak terkendali dan mencegah parasit menempel pada inang.

quote: Perasan daun pepaya ≤ 30% dengan lama perendaman 20 menit aman digunakan sebagai pengendali investasi Argulus pada ikan komet.
statement: Perasan daun pepaya dengan konsentrasi ≤ 30% dan lama perendaman 20 menit aman untuk mengendalikan infestasi Argulus pada ikan komet.
text_en: Perasan daun pepaya dengan konsentrasi ≤ 30% dan lama perendaman 20 menit aman untuk mengendalikan infestasi Argulus pada ikan komet.

quote: Perasan daun pepaya (Carica papaya L.) dapat digunakan sebagai pengendali infestasi Argulus pada ikan komet (Carassius auratus auratus) dengan konsentrasi perasan daun pepaya (Carica papaya L.) 30% selama 20 menit.
statement: Kesimpulan menyatakan bahwa perasan daun pepaya konsentrasi 30% selama 20 menit efektif sebagai pengendali infestasi Argulus pada ikan komet.
text_en: Kesimpulan menyatakan bahwa perasan daun pepaya konsentrasi 30% selama 20 menit efektif sebagai pengendali infestasi Argulus pada ikan komet.

quote: Pengaplikasian perasan daun pepaya sebaiknya memperhatikan konsentrasi perasan dan lama perendaman, karena konsentrasi yang terlalu berlebihan (>30%) dan lama perendaman lebih dari 20 menit dapat mengakibatkan kematian pada ikan.
statement: Konsentrasi perasan daun pepaya >30% atau lama perendaman >20 menit dapat menyebabkan kematian pada ikan.
text_en: Konsentrasi perasan daun pepaya >30% atau lama perendaman >20 menit dapat menyebabkan kematian pada ikan.

quote: However, at dietary 100% replacement of FM by BLEND A, the mRNA expression of il-10 was significantly downregulated, and intestinal tissue damage occurred, showing a large number of lymphocytes infiltrated into the epithelial cells and the Vh became shorter.
statement: 然而，在用BLEND A 100%替代鱼粉的日粮中，il-10的mRNA表达显著下调，并发生肠组织损伤，表现为大量淋巴细胞浸润上皮细胞且绒毛高度变短。
text_zh: 然而，在用BLEND A 100%替代鱼粉的日粮中，il-10的mRNA表达显著下调，并发生肠组织损伤，表现为大量淋巴细胞浸润上皮细胞且绒毛高度变短。
text_en: However, in diets with BLEND A replacing 100% of fish meal, il-10 mRNA expression was significantly downregulated, and intestinal tissue damage occurred, characterized by massive lymphocyte infiltration into epithelial cells and shortened villus height.

quote: This suggested that the inflammation development of the intestine of gibel carp was not conducive to protein digestion and absorption.
statement: 这表明鲫鱼肠道的炎症发展不利于蛋白质消化和吸收。
text_zh: 这表明鲫鱼肠道的炎症发展不利于蛋白质消化和吸收。
text_en: This indicates that the development of inflammation in the intestine of crucian carp is detrimental to protein digestion and absorption.

quote: Similarly, dietary high single protein CAP was reported to cause intestinal inflammation in yellow croaker (L. crocea) [ 16 ].
statement: 类似地，据报道高单一蛋白CAP日粮会导致大黄鱼（L. crocea）肠道炎症。
text_zh: 类似地，据报道高单一蛋白CAP日粮会导致大黄鱼（L. crocea）肠道炎症。
text_en: Similarly, it is reported that high single-protein CAP diets cause intestinal inflammation in large yellow croaker (L. crocea).

quote: This study found that dietary replacement of FM by blended proteins upregulated the mRNA expression of tight junction-related genes and improved the tight junction damage.
statement: 本研究发现，用混合蛋白替代鱼粉上调了紧密连接相关基因的mRNA表达，并改善了紧密连接损伤。
text_zh: 本研究发现，用混合蛋白替代鱼粉上调了紧密连接相关基因的mRNA表达，并改善了紧密连接损伤。
text_en: This study found that replacing fishmeal with mixed protein upregulated the mRNA expression of tight junction-related genes and improved tight junction damage.

quote: It was reported that the upregulation of tight junction-related gene expression favored the integrity of the intestinal epithelium [ 58 , 59 ].
statement: 据报道，紧密连接相关基因表达的上调有利于肠上皮的完整性。
text_zh: 据报道，紧密连接相关基因表达的上调有利于肠上皮的完整性。
text_en: It is reported that the upregulation of tight junction-related gene expression benefits intestinal epithelial integrity.

quote: It suggested that dietary blended proteins of inappropriate ratios could lead to intestinal inflammation of gibel carp.
statement: 这表明比例不当的混合蛋白日粮可能导致鲫鱼肠道炎症。
text_zh: 这表明比例不当的混合蛋白日粮可能导致鲫鱼肠道炎症。
text_en: This indicates that mixed protein diets with improper ratios may cause intestinal inflammation in crucian carp.

quote: However, intestinal immunity and physical barrier could be improved with proper composition of blend proteins.
statement: 然而，适当的混合蛋白组成可以改善肠道免疫和物理屏障。
text_zh: 然而，适当的混合蛋白组成可以改善肠道免疫和物理屏障。
text_en: However, an appropriate mixed protein composition can improve intestinal immunity and the physical barrier.

quote: This study found that the substitution of FM by blended proteins upregulated the mRNA expression of intestinal amino acid sensory receptor-related genes in gibel carp.
statement: 本研究发现，用混合蛋白替代鱼粉上调了鲫鱼肠道氨基酸感觉受体相关基因的mRNA表达。
text_zh: 本研究发现，用混合蛋白替代鱼粉上调了鲫鱼肠道氨基酸感觉受体相关基因的mRNA表达。
text_en: This study found that replacing fishmeal with mixed protein upregulated the mRNA expression of amino acid sensing receptor-related genes in the intestine of crucian carp.

quote: Hasil pengamatan tingkah laku ikan secara garis besar menunjukkan tingkah laku ikan setelah direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya hampir sama dengan tingkah laku ikan yang sehat.
statement: Secara umum, perilaku ikan setelah direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya hampir sama dengan perilaku ikan yang sehat.
text_en: Secara umum, perilaku ikan setelah direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya hampir sama dengan perilaku ikan yang sehat.

quote: Ikan pada saat direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya 20%, 25% dan 30% memiliki pergerakan operkulum lebih cepat dibandingkan ikan yang sehat.
statement: Ikan yang direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya konsentrasi 20%, 25%, dan 30% menunjukkan pergerakan operkulum yang lebih cepat dibandingkan ikan sehat.
text_en: Ikan yang direndam dalam perasan daun pepaya konsentrasi 20%, 25%, dan 30% menunjukkan pergerakan operkulum yang lebih cepat dibandingkan ikan sehat.

quote: Adanya penurunan kandungan oksigen terlarut, mengakibatkan ikan akan mempercepat gerakan operkulum untuk mendapatkan gas oksigen dengan cepat sesuai kebutuhan respirasinya.
statement: Penurunan kadar oksigen terlarut menyebabkan ikan mempercepat gerakan operkulum untuk memenuhi kebutuhan respirasi.
text_en: Penurunan kadar oksigen terlarut menyebabkan ikan mempercepat gerakan operkulum untuk memenuhi kebutuhan respirasi.

quote: Berdasarkan hasil pengamatan kualitas air, kondisi suhu dan DO pada air perlakuan masih dikatakan baik karena masih dalam kisaran dimana ikan komet masih dapat hidup.
statement: Kondisi suhu dan oksigen terlarut (DO) pada air perlakuan dinilai baik karena masih berada dalam kisaran toleransi hidup ikan komet.
text_en: Kondisi suhu dan oksigen terlarut (DO) pada air perlakuan dinilai baik karena masih berada dalam kisaran toleransi hidup ikan komet.

quote: The decreased Vh and V/C implied reduced nutrient absorption and growth retardation [ 49 ].
statement: 绒毛高度（Vh）和绒毛/隐窝比（V/C）的降低意味着营养吸收减少和生长迟缓。
text_zh: 绒毛高度（Vh）和绒毛/隐窝比（V/C）的降低意味着营养吸收减少和生长迟缓。
text_en: A decrease in villus height (Vh) and the villus/crypt ratio (V/C) means reduced nutrient absorption and growth retardation.

quote: This study showed that dietary 100% replacement of FM by blended proteins upregulated the mRNA expression of intestinal proinflammatory cytokines (tnf-α , il-6α , il-8 , and/or il-1β).
statement: 本研究表明，用混合蛋白100%替代鱼粉上调了肠道促炎细胞因子（tnf-α、il-6α、il-8和/或il-1β）的mRNA表达。
text_zh: 本研究表明，用混合蛋白100%替代鱼粉上调了肠道促炎细胞因子（tnf-α、il-6α、il-8和/或il-1β）的mRNA表达。
text_en: This study showed that replacing fishmeal with 100% mixed protein upregulated the mRNA expression of intestinal pro-inflammatory cytokines (tnf-α, il-6α, il-8 and/or il-1β).
